rows.translation: Noti zilezile tano hurudiwa juu ya shingo. Umbo 2 huanza umbo 1 linapoishia: kidole 1 freti 7 kwenye nyuzi 5, 4 na 3, kidole 2 freti 8 kwenye nyuzi 6, 2 na 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: freti 8 na 10. Uzi 5: freti 7 na 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Nyuzi 6, 5 na 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Ni noti zipi ziko katika umbo 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Noti tano zilezile za umbo 1, A C D E G, mahali papya kwenye shingo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Nyuzi 3, 2 na 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kiungo: teleza juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Kutoka umbo 1 hadi umbo 2, telezesha kidole 3 kutoka freti 7 hadi freti 9 kwenye uzi 3. Unafika umbo 2 mkono ukiwa tayari mahali pake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kutoka umbo 1 hadi umbo 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Umbo 2, panda na ushuke
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Saltwater Sunday
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · title

rows.translation: Solo juu ya mdundo wa reggae
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Saltwater Sunday ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: reggae tulivu katika A minori, Am7 na D7 zikipokezana vipimo. Maumbo yote mawili ya pentatoniki yanafaa. Fanya hammer-on, pull-off na slide; tua kwenye noti ya kodi kila kipimo kinapoanza. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hammer-on na pull-off, umbo 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Kwa D7, ni noti ipi ya maumbo haya iliyo sehemu ya kodi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 ni D, F diesi, A na C. C, noti yake ya saba, husikika imetulia; E na G hupita tu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Teleza juu hadi umbo 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Solo yako kwa Am7 na D7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Jaribio la gitaa la solo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · title

rows.translation: Vishazi vyenye hisia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, noti lengwa za bend, vibrato na maumbo yote mawili. Piga kila kishazi kwa usafi, kisha kifanye kiimbe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Bend ya toni nzima kutoka freti 7 ilingane na…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti 9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti 12
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Noti lengwa, kisha bend. Noti ileile au tofauti?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umbo 1 hadi umbo 2, kwa hisia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kuhamisha kodi za bare
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · title

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Maumbo ya E na A juu ya shingo, meja na minori, umbo la karibu zaidi na mfuatano katika A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: Umbo la E huhama
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · title

rows.translation: F ni mwanzo tu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Bare yako ya F ni umbo la E lenye bare kwenye freti 1. Hamisha umbo zima juu; jina hufuata noti msingi kwenye uzi 6: freti 3 ni G, freti 5 ni A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la E kwenye freti 5. Kodi gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Uzi 6 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka E: F kwenye 1, G kwenye 3, A kwenye 5. Freti ya bare ndiyo huipa kodi jina.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Minori: inua kidole 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Inua kidole 2 na uache bare ishike uzi 3. Hilo ni umbo la E minori, na huhama vivyo hivyo: F diesi minori freti 2, A minori freti 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Umbo la A huhama
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title

rows.translation: Umbo la A, msingi kwenye uzi 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B minori ilikuwa umbo la A minori lenye bare. Umbo la A meja huhama pia: fanya bare kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 5, kisha laza kidole 3 juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2, freti mbili juu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la A kwenye freti 3. Kodi gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka A: B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, D kwenye 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Umbo la A minori huhama pia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Kwa minori, tumia vidole vya B minori: 2, 3 na 4 huunda mpangilio wa A minori mbele ya bare. Kwenye freti 3 hiyo ni C minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Umbo la E au la A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · title

rows.translation: Kila kodi ina makao mawili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Kodi nyingi zinaweza kuwa umbo la E, msingi kwenye uzi 6, au umbo la A, msingi kwenye uzi 5. Chagua lililo karibu zaidi na mkono wako ulipo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Unapiga G kwenye freti 3. C ya karibu zaidi iko wapi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umbo la E kwenye freti 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Umbo la A kwenye freti 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Umbo la A kwenye freti 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C iko kwenye uzi 5, freti 3. Baki freti 3 na ubadili kuwa umbo la A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.translation: Shikilia bare, badili umbo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Kutoka G hadi C kwenye freti 3, kidole 1 hubaki kwenye bare. Vidole vya mbele yake tu ndivyo hubadilika. Hili ndilo badiliko laini zaidi la bare.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: D ya umbo la A iko kwenye freti gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Uzi 5: A wazi, B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, D kwenye 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.translation: F diesi minori, D, A, E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · title

rows.translation: Ufunguo mpya: A meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: F diesi minori, D, A na E zote ziko katika ufunguo wa A. Anza na F diesi minori kama bare na kodi nyingine tatu zikiwa wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: F diesi minori kama bare ya umbo la E iko…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: F kwenye freti 1, F diesi kwenye freti 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Sasa zote kwa bare
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Piga juu ya shingo: F diesi minori freti 2, D kwa umbo la A freti 5, A kwa umbo la E freti 5, na E kwa umbo la A freti 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mabadiliko laini ya bare
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title

rows.translation: Legeza kati ya kodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Legeza bare kwa muda mfupi unaposogea, kisha bonyeza unapotua. Kukaza njiani kote huchosha mkono na kuchelewesha badiliko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Mkono wa freti unapaswa kubonyeza lini?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kila wakati
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Wakati wa kutua kwenye kodi tu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kamwe
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Bonyeza kutua, legeza kusogea. Nguvu ya daima huchosha mkono ndani ya dakika chache.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Endelea kupiga unapohama
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu kabla ya badiliko, inua bare na uendelee kupiga. Nyuzi wazi hulia kwa muda mfupi, mdundo hausimami, na unatua kwa wakati.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Spray Paint Sunrise
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · title

rows.translation: Bare mbili, familia moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Spray Paint Sunrise ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: indie pop katika E kwa E, B, C diesi minori na A. B na C diesi minori ni bare za umbo la A, zikitengana kwa freti mbili; umbo moja la mkono hufanya kazi kubwa zaidi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: C diesi minori kama bare ya umbo la A minori iko…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 5 huhesabiwa kupanda kutoka A: B kwenye 2, C kwenye 3, C diesi kwenye 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la bare
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · title

rows.translation: Panda na ushuke kwenye shingo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: maumbo ya E na A, meja na minori, kuchagua umbo la karibu na kubadili kwa ulaini. Legeza kati ya kodi na utue kwenye pigo la kwanza.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Bare ya umbo la E kwenye freti 3 ni…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Noti msingi kwenye uzi 5 ina maana umbo gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umbo la E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Umbo la A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mitindo ya mdundo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · title

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Noti za kumi na sita na mikwaruzo ya funk, chop ya reggae, boom-chick ya country na mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary

rows.translation: Noti za kumi na sita
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title

rows.translation: Nne kwa kila pigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Noti za kumi na sita hugawa kila pigo mara nne: moja-e-na-a, mbili-e-na-a. Mkono wa kupiga huwa na kasi maradufu, chini-juu-chini-juu ndani ya kila pigo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za kumi na sita hujaza pigo moja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Moja-e-na-a: sehemu nne sawa za kila pigo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi ya funk: E9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk hupenda kodi ya tisa. Kidole 2 kwenye uzi 5, freti 7, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 4, freti 6, na kidole 3 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 kwenye freti 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Funk: mikwaruzo na mapigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title

rows.translation: Nyamazisha, kisha piga
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Endelea kusogeza mkono kwa noti za kumi na sita, lakini legeza vidole vya freti ili mapigo mengi yawe milio mifupi ya kukwaruza. Bonyeza tu kwenye mapigo ya kodi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nini hutoa mkwaruzo?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Vidole vya freti kugusa nyuzi kwa upole
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kupiga nyuzi kwa kiganja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kupiga uzi kwa gumba
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Kugusa bila kubonyeza huzuia nyuzi kulia. Mpigo unakuwa mlio mfupi na safi wa kugonga.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapigo mafupi, na D9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Bonyeza kwa kila pigo, kisha legeza mara moja ili liwe fupi. Hamisha umbo zima la E9 freti mbili chini kupata D9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Reggae: chop nje ya pigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title

rows.translation: Chop kwenye mbili na nne
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Gitaa la reggae hujibu ngoma kwa kodi fupi, angavu kwenye mapigo ya pili na ya nne. Piga nyuzi nyembamba tu na ukatishe kila kodi mara moja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Maumbo madogo ya sauti ya juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Tumia nyuzi nne za juu tu. A minori hii ni sehemu ya juu ya bare yako ya A minori freti 5: kidole 3 kwenye uzi 4, freti 7, kidole 1 kikiwa bare kwenye zilizobaki.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Chop ya reggae inapaswa kulia kwa muda gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwa muda mrefu iwezekanavyo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwa muda mfupi sana
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Pigo moja kamili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Bonyeza, piga, achia. Chop ni mlio mfupi mkali, na nafasi baada yake ndiyo huleta mdundo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D, sehemu ya juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Sasa sehemu ya juu ya bare yako ya D: kidole 3 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 freti 7, kidole 1 kwenye uzi 1 freti 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Boom-chick ya country
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title

rows.translation: Besi, nyuzi, besi, nyuzi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Mdundo wa country hugawa kipimo: noti moja ya besi kwenye mapigo ya kwanza na ya tatu, mpigo wa haraka wa nyuzi nyembamba kwenye pili na nne. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Boom katika G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Katika boom-chick, nini hutokea kwenye mapigo ya pili na ya nne?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti moja ya besi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.translation: Mpigo mfupi wa nyuzi nyembamba
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hakuna chochote
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Pokezana besi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Hamishia boom ya pili kwenye uzi mwingine: katika G, uzi 6 kisha uzi 4. Katika C, uzi 5 kisha 4. Katika D, uzi 4 kisha uzi 5 wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Boom katika G, C na D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title

rows.translation: Ruka mapigo makuu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huweka mpigo wa nyuzi mahali usipoutarajia. Chini kwenye moja, juu kwenye na ya mbili, juu kwenye na ya tatu, kisha chini-juu kwenye nne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Katika mpangilio huu, mkono hufanya nini kwenye pigo la pili?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Unapiga chini kwa nguvu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Unashuka bila kugusa nyuzi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Pendulamu haisimami kamwe. Kwenye mbili mkono hushuka bila kugusa nyuzi, tayari kwa mpigo wa juu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Badili mapema kidogo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa pop mara nyingi hubadili kodi kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu, na ya nne, ili kodi mpya ifike mapema kidogo. Hilo husukuma wimbo mbele.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Sparkler Season
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.translation: Mpigo wa pop kwa kodi nne
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sparkler Season ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: wimbo wa pamoja wa kiangazi katika C kwa C, G, A minori na F. Upe mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa na ubadili mapema kidogo, kwenye na ya nne. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: E wazi na D freti 3 kwenye uzi 2, mara mbili, kisha G freti 3 kwenye uzi 1, na shuka tena hadi D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Kwa nini ubadili kodi kwenye na ya nne?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Ili kodi mpya ilie kwenye pigo la kwanza
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kupunguza kasi ya wimbo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kuruka kodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Kusogea kwenye mpigo wa mwisho wa juu hufikisha mkono mapema kidogo, hivyo kodi mpya huwa tayari kwa pigo la kwanza.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la mitindo ya mdundo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · title

rows.translation: Midundo minne, mkono mmoja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: noti za kumi na sita za funk, chop ya reggae, boom-chick na mpigo wa pop wa sinkopa. Endelea kubembeza mkono na ubadili tu kinachopigwa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Chop za reggae hutua kwenye mapigo gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Moja na tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mbili na nne
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kila pigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kuunganisha yote
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapo, maumbo ya G na D kwa kapo 2, na Oh! Susanna iliyopangwa kwa ubeti na kiitikio.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kapo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title

rows.translation: Kifaa cha kubana kwenye shingo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapo hubana kila uzi kwenye freti moja. Ikiwa freti 2, kila uzi wazi husikika freti mbili juu, na maumbo yako yote ya kodi wazi hupanda nayo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kapo: piga nyuzi 1 na 2 wazi. Hizo ni E na B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Sasa bana kapo nyuma kidogo ya freti 2 na uzipige tena: F diesi na C diesi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Unapiga umbo la G. Kodi gani inasikika?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya G ni A. Umbo hubaki G; sauti hupanda pamoja na kapo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fikiria kwa maumbo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: Ukiwa na kapo bado unafikiria G, C na D, maumbo unayojua. Michoro hapa hutaja kodi unayosikia kweli, kwa hiyo umbo la G kwa kapo 2 huitwa A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Maumbo ya G na D kwa kapo 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.translation: Familia ya G, freti mbili juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Kwa kapo 2, maumbo ya G, C, D na E minori husikika kama A, D, E na F diesi minori. Vidole vilevile, ufunguo mpya: A meja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo la D husikika kama…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya D ni E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Familia ya D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Maumbo ya D hufanya kazi vivyo hivyo. Kwa kapo 2, maumbo ya D, G na A husikika kama E, A na B: ufunguo wa E kwa upangaji rahisi wa vidole wa kodi wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Oh! Susanna: ubeti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title

rows.translation: Ubeti, kisha kiitikio
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi hupokezana sehemu mbili. Ubeti husimulia; kiitikio hurudia kishazi cha kuvutia. Oh! Susanna ya Stephen Foster (1848) ina zote mbili. Ondoa kapo: iko katika G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Utangulizi na kipimo cha kwanza: G wazi, A freti 2, kisha B wazi, D freti 3 mara mbili, na E wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Sehemu gani kwa kawaida hurudi na maneno yaleyale?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Utangulizi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Beti hubadili maneno kadiri hadithi inavyoendelea. Kiitikio hurudi bila kubadilika, na hicho ndicho watu huimba pamoja nacho.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi chini ya ubeti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Sindikiza ubeti kwa G na D7, mtindo wa boom-chick: besi kwenye moja, nyuzi kwenye mbili. Vipimo vitatu vya G, kimoja cha D7, viwili vya G, kisha D7 na G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ubeti, kwa mtiririko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Oh! Susanna: kiitikio
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title

rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia huanza juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Kiitikio huanza kwenye C, uzi 2, freti 1, kisha huruka hadi E wazi. Kodi zake ni C, G na D7, na nusu yake ya pili inafanana na mwisho wa ubeti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: C mara mbili kwenye uzi 2, freti 1, kisha E wazi mara tatu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Kisha shuka: D mara mbili, B wazi, G wazi, na A freti 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Noti tatu za E ni fupi, ndefu, fupi. Ile ndefu huanza wapi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye pigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Katikati ya pigo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Huanza kwenye na na huendelea kulia katika pigo linalofuata. Msukumo huo ni sinkopa, kama mpigo wako wa pop.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mpangilio wako
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title

rows.translation: Panga wimbo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Mpangilio huamua unachopiga na wakati wa kukipiga. Wako: utangulizi kwa mtindo wa Travis, ubeti kama melodi, kiitikio kwa boom-chick, kisha melodi ya kiitikio kumalizia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Utangulizi: Travis kwa G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Utangulizi hufanya nini?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Huanzisha ufunguo na tempo kabla ya melodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Huchukua nafasi ya ubeti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hurudia maneno ya kiitikio
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Vipimo vichache vya kodi huwaambia wote noti msingi ni ipi na kasi ni ipi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ubeti: melodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Malizia kwa kishazi cha kuvutia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Malizia kwa melodi ya kiitikio na uache G ya mwisho ilie. Kumalizia kwa melodi ambayo wote wamesikia sasa hivi huleta ukamilifu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kiitikio: melodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Gravel Road Two-Step
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · title

rows.translation: Country yenye kapo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Gravel Road Two-Step ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: country ya dansi katika A, kwa A, D na E. Bana kapo kwenye freti 2 na upige kwa maumbo ya G, C na D, unayoyajua vizuri zaidi. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo gani husikika kama E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umbo la D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Umbo la C
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Umbo la G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Freti mbili juu ya D ni E. Kwa kapo 2, umbo la G hutoa A, na umbo la C hutoa D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mtindo wa two-step
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Piga noti msingi ya kodi kwenye mapigo ya kwanza na ya tatu, na nyuzi kwenye pili na nne, kila moja likifuatwa haraka na pigo la juu. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: hatua za wachezaji dansi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Onyesho la mwisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · title

rows.translation: Onyesho lako
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kapo, maumbo ya G na D, na mpangilio wako wa Oh! Susanna. Piga kana kwamba mtu anakusikiliza. Labda yupo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapo freti 2. Umbo la C husikika kama…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Bila kapo: utangulizi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Oh! Susanna, kwa kasi kamili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mfumo wa CAGED
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 “The CAGED system” · title

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Maumbo matano wazi yanakuwa sehemu tano za kupiga G, na kodi zilizo karibu na mkono wako.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 “The CAGED system” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kodi moja, maumbo matano
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · title

rows.translation: CAGED: maumbo matano
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Kila kodi meja inaweza kukopa umbo la C, A, G, E au D wazi, likihamishwa juu ya shingo. Ukipanda kuanzia umbo lolote, hufuata mpangilio huo, C A G E D, na kila moja huungana na linalofuata.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Jina CAGED hutokana na…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti tano
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Maumbo matano ya kodi wazi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Nyuzi tano
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E na D: maumbo matano wazi ambayo kila kodi meja inaweza kukopa popote kwenye shingo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Inayofuata: umbo la E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Panda kutoka G wazi; umbo linalofuata ni la E: bare yako ya G freti 3. Noti yake msingi kwenye uzi 6 ni G ileile ya kodi wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi ileile au tofauti?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umbo la D kwenye freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: D wazi ikihamishwa freti tano juu huwa G. Kidole 1 hushika uzi 4 freti 5, kikichukua nafasi ya nati ya nyuzi. Vidole 2, 4 na 3 huunda upya pembetatu ya D juu yake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.translation: Umbo la D, uzi kwa uzi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya umbo la D iko wapi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Uzi 1, chini ya kidole 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi 3, chini ya kidole 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi 4, chini ya kidole 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya D wazi ni uzi 4 wazi. Ikihamishwa juu, kidole 1 huishika: G freti 5. Uzi 2, freti 8 pia ni G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti inayoshirikiwa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Umbo la E freti 3 na umbo la D freti 5 hushiriki noti moja: G kwenye uzi 4, freti 5. Itazame unapohama kati ya maumbo hayo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Umbo la C kwenye freti 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: C wazi ikihamishwa freti saba juu huwa G. Kidole 1 hulala juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 freti 7, kidole 2 hushika uzi 2 freti 8, na vidole 3 na 4 hunyooshwa hadi nyuzi 4 na 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.translation: Umbo la C, uzi kwa uzi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kama C wazi, noti msingi ya umbo la C iko kwenye…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Noti msingi ya C wazi iko uzi 5, freti 3. Hapa kidole kidogo huishika: G freti 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi yoyote, umbo lilelile
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo la C chini hadi freti 2 liwe D, msingi wake ukiwa uzi 5, freti 5. Jina hufuata noti msingi daima.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.translation: Umbo la A, na mzunguko tena
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title

rows.translation: Umbo la A kwenye freti 10
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Fanya bare kwenye nyuzi 5 hadi 1 freti 10 na ulaze kidole 3 juu ya nyuzi 4, 3 na 2 freti 12. Ni bare yako ya umbo la A, na ni G tena.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Freti 12 huanza mzunguko upya
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Baada ya umbo la A, umbo la G hurudi freti 12: G wazi, oktava moja juu. Kutoka hapo maumbo matano hurudiwa kwa mpangilio uleule.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Ukipanda shingo, umbo gani hufuata A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Mpangilio hurudiwa: C, A, G, E, D, kisha C tena. Baada ya A huja G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ni G ipi iliyo juu zaidi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kodi karibu na mkono wako
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · title

rows.translation: Baki sehemu moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: Kwa CAGED huhitaji kuruka mara nyingi. Karibu na freti 5, G ni umbo la D, C ni umbo la G, na D ni umbo la A. Kodi tatu, sehemu moja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Umbo gani hupiga C karibu kabisa na G ya umbo la D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Umbo la G la kodi C hutumia freti 5 na 8, palepale mkono wako ulipo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Au baki kwenye freti 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Wazo lilelile hufanya kazi chini: G kwa umbo la E freti 3, C kwa umbo la A freti 3, na D kwa umbo la C freti 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Lantern Hill
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title

rows.translation: Wimbo mmoja, sehemu tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: wa kuimba pamoja kuzunguka moto kwa G, C na D. Piga kiitikio kwa kodi wazi, kisha karibu na freti 5, kisha freti 3, na wimbo uleule huhama kwenye shingo. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Karibu na freti 5, umbo gani hupiga C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: Umbo la G la kodi C hutumia freti 5 na 8, karibu kabisa na G ya umbo la D na D ya umbo la A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kiitikio, noti moja moja freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Jaribio la CAGED
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · title

rows.translation: Maumbo matano, shingo moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: G katika maumbo yote matano, na G, C na D karibu na freti 3 na freti 5. Taja kila umbo unapotua.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.translation: G kwa umbo la D iko kwenye…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu juu ya shingo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu kwenye nyuzi za juu: meja na minori, kila mgeuzo, na mifuatano inayosogea kidogo sana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu kwenye nyuzi za juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title

rows.translation: Noti tatu huunda kodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu ndiyo kodi kamili ndogo zaidi: noti msingi, ya tatu na ya tano. Kwenye nyuzi 3, 2 na 1, kodi hizi hulia kwa usafi na uangavu na hutumika popote kwenye shingo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: C, noti msingi chini
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi huunda kodi ya noti tatu ya C meja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C, E na G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C, D na E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C, F na A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Msingi, ya tatu, ya tano: kutoka C, ruka herufi moja hadi E, kisha ruka nyingine hadi G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti zilezile, mpangilio mpya
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Hamishia noti ya chini zaidi juu upate mgeuzo. E ikiwa chini, C iko freti 9, 8 na 8. G ikiwa chini, ni sehemu ya juu ya C yako wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mageuzo ya G na D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title

rows.translation: Maumbo matatu kwa kila kodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Kila kodi meja ya noti tatu kwenye nyuzi hizi hutumia moja ya maumbo matatu, moja kwa kila mgeuzo. Yajifunze kwa G na D uweze kupata kodi yoyote meja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G kwenye freti 4, 3 na 3 ina umbo sawa na…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C kwenye freti 5, 5 na 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C kwenye freti 9, 8 na 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hakuna kodi nyingine
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Zote huweka noti ya tatu chini: freti moja juu kwenye uzi 3, nyingine mbili zikiwa sawa. Umbo lilelile, zimetengana freti tano.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D, mara mbili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D kwenye freti 7, 7 na 5 ina umbo lenye noti msingi chini kama C yako freti 5. Chini zaidi, freti 2, 3 na 2 ni sehemu ya juu ya D yako wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi minori za noti tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title

rows.translation: Shusha noti ya tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Kodi minori ya noti tatu ni kodi meja ambayo noti yake ya tatu imeshushwa freti moja. Kwenye nyuzi hizi, A minori freti 2, 1 na 0 ni sehemu ya juu ya A minori yako wazi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: A minori kwenye freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Fanya bare kwenye freti 5 juu ya nyuzi 3, 2 na 1 kupata A minori yenye C chini. Kidole kimoja, noti tatu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: E minori pembeni yake
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E minori kwenye freti 4, 5 na 3 huweka B chini. Iko karibu kabisa na A minori freti 5, hivyo badiliko ni dogo sana.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mfuatano wa kodi za noti tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title

rows.translation: Hamia umbo la karibu zaidi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Chagua mgeuzo wa karibu zaidi na mkono ili mfuatano usogee kidogo sana. G, E minori, C na D zote ziko kati ya freti 2 na 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Kutoka G freti 4, 3, 3 hadi E minori freti 4, 5, 3, ni noti zipi hubaki?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D tu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: B na G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B kwenye uzi 3 na G kwenye uzi 1 hubaki palepale. Uzi 2 tu hubadilika, kutoka D hadi E juu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Juu zaidi kwenye shingo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Kodi zilezile nne ziko juu pia: G freti 7, 8 na 7, E minori freti 9, 8 na 7, C freti 9, 8 na 8, na D freti 7, 7 na 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Arpeggio za kodi za noti tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title

rows.translation: Piga noti zake moja moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Piga noti za kodi ya noti tatu moja moja upate arpeggio. Katika mfuatano wa kodi, noti huunda melodi yake yenyewe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Arpeggio, freti 2 hadi 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Arpeggio ni nini?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.translation: Kodi inayopigwa noti moja moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi inayopigwa mara mbili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli inayopigwa haraka
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Arpeggio kwa noti za nane
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Sikiliza noti ya juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Noti za juu hapa ni G, G, G, F diesi: karibu hazisogei huku kodi zikibadilika chini yake. Noti ambayo kodi mbili hushiriki ndiyo noti ya pamoja, na ndiyo hufanya kodi za noti tatu zisikike laini.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: Noti ya juu ilipanda au ilishuka?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Arpeggio, freti 5 hadi 9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Roller Rink
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu ukumbini mwa dansi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: pop ya dansi ya mtindo wa zamani kwa G, E minori, C na D, kodi zako za noti tatu kati ya freti 2 na 5. Maumbo madogo kwenye nyuzi za juu husikika angavu na thabiti, kama gitaa la pili. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Mzunguko wa Roller Rink ni moja, sita, nne na tano za G. Kodi ipi ni sita?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda G meja: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Kodi kwenye 6 ni minori: E minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu, kutoka uzi wa juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Jaribio la kodi za noti tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · title

rows.translation: Maumbo madogo, shingo nzima
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi meja na minori za noti tatu, mageuzo yake, G, E minori, C na D sehemu mbili, na arpeggio. Kila mwendo uwe mdogo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Kodi minori ya noti tatu ni kodi meja yenye…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti msingi freti moja juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti ya tatu freti moja chini
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti ya ziada juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi za saba na upangaji wa jazz
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · title

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Kodi za saba meja, minori na dominanti, wazi na za bare, ii–V–I, na usindikizaji wa swing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kodi za saba meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title

rows.translation: Ongeza noti ya saba
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Kodi ya saba meja huongeza noti iliyo freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi. Huifanya kodi meja ya kawaida iwe laini na ya ndotoni. Cmaj7 wazi ni C ikiwa kidole 1 kimeinuliwa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 ni C yenye noti gani ya ziada?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: B bemoli
