rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Noti ya saba meja iko freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi: B, chini kidogo ya C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fmaj7: achia uzi wa juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Piga F ndogo, lakini kidole 1 kibonyeze uzi 2 tu. Uzi 1 wazi, E, ni noti ya saba meja ya F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi za saba minori
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title

rows.translation: Minori tulivu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Kodi ya saba minori huongeza noti iliyo freti mbili chini ya oktava ya noti msingi. Husikika tulivu, kati ya giza na uangavu. Am7 ni A minori ikiwa kidole 3 kimeinuliwa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dm7 na Em7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3, freti 2, na kidole 1 kimelala juu ya nyuzi 2 na 1 freti 1. Em7: kidole 2 pekee kwenye uzi 5, freti 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 ni A minori yenye noti gani ya ziada?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Noti ya saba minori iko freti mbili chini ya oktava ya noti msingi: G, freti mbili chini ya A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Kodi za saba, msingi kwenye uzi 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title

rows.translation: Cmaj7 kwenye freti 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 hushika uzi 5 freti 3 na hulala hadi uzi 1. Kidole 3 hushika uzi 4, kidole 2 uzi 3 na kidole 4 uzi 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Dm7 na D7 kwenye freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 ni bare yako ya A minori ikiwa kidole kidogo kimeinuliwa. D7 ni bare ya umbo la A yenye vidole 3 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 4 na 2. Zote hupata jina kutoka uzi 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 kwenye freti 5. Noti yake msingi iko wapi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Uzi 4, freti 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi 5, freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi 1, freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kama kila kodi ya umbo la A, hupata jina kutoka noti yake kwenye uzi 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mfuatano wa ii–V–I
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title

rows.translation: Mbili, tano, moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Mwendo pendwa wa jazz: kodi kwenye noti ya pili ya ufunguo, kisha ya tano, kisha msingi. Katika C ni Dm7, G7 na Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G7 kwa bare
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Piga umbo la E7 kama bare kwenye freti 3: kidole 1 juu ya nyuzi zote sita, kidole 3 kwenye uzi 5 na kidole 2 kwenye uzi 3. Noti msingi iko kwenye uzi 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni ii?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda kutoka C: C ni moja, D ni mbili. Kodi ya saba inayojengwa kwenye D ni D minori saba.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fupi na safi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa jazz mara nyingi huacha kila kodi ilie kwa muda mfupi tu. Bonyeza unapopiga, legeza mara moja baada yake, na kodi zitaanza kuwa na swing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Usindikizaji wa swing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title

rows.translation: Mdundo wa Charleston
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa gitaa la swing husindikiza bendi kwa kodi fupi zinazoijibu. Mdundo wa Charleston hupiga kwenye pigo la kwanza na na ya pili yenye swing, kisha huacha nafasi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: ii–V–I katika G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: Katika G, mbili, tano, moja ni Am7, D7 na Gmaj7. Am7 ni bare ya E minori saba freti 5; Gmaj7 huruka uzi 5, msingi wake ukiwa uzi 6, freti 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Late Checkout
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title

rows.translation: Mzunguko wa ii–V–I
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Late Checkout ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: lo-fi katika C kwa Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 na Am7. Huo ni ii–V–I pamoja na kodi ya sita kurudia mwanzo. Sindikiza kwa kodi zako za saba za bare na Charleston. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Katika Late Checkout, kodi ipi ni V?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda C meja: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Kodi ya saba kwenye G ni G7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la kodi za jazz
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title

rows.translation: Kodi za saba kwa swing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: kodi za saba meja, minori na dominanti, wazi na za bare, na ii–V–I katika C na G. Kodi ziwe fupi na swing iwe thabiti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Noti gani ya saba iko freti moja chini ya oktava ya noti msingi?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ya saba minori
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ya saba meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli ya meja, mkono sehemu moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G meja kwa oktava mbili freti 2, madaraja ya skeli na kodi, na modi za Dorian na Mixolydian.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary

rows.translation: Umbo la skeli ya meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title

rows.translation: Toni nzima na nusu toni
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Nusu toni ni freti moja, toni nzima ni mbili. Kila skeli meja hupanda nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu. Mpangilio huo huipa meja sauti yake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G meja kwenye freti 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Weka kidole 1 freti 2 na kila kidole kiwe na freti yake hadi freti 5. Kutoka G kwenye uzi 6, freti 3, skeli hupanda kupitia nyuzi 6, 5 na 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Uzi 6: freti 3 na 5, vidole 2 na 4. Uzi 5: freti 2 na 3, vidole 1 na 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Uzi 5, freti 5, kisha uzi 4: freti 2, 4 na 5. Rudi kwenye G msingi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Nusu toni ziko wapi katika skeli meja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kati ya noti 3 na 4, na 7 na 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kati ya kila jozi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kati ya noti 1 na 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Nzima, nzima, nusu: nusu toni ya kwanza ni kutoka 3 hadi 4. Nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu: ya pili ni kutoka 7 hadi 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Oktava moja, panda na ushuke
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Oktava mbili, mkono sehemu moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title

rows.translation: Oktava ya pili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Nafasi ileile inaendelea: A, B na C kwenye uzi 3, D na E kwenye uzi 2, F diesi na G kwenye uzi 1. Mkono hauhami.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 3: freti 2, 4, 5. Uzi 2: freti 3, 5. Uzi 1: freti 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Oktava ya juu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi hii, kidole gani hupiga freti 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Kidole 1 kiko freti 2, kwa hiyo freti 5 ni ya kidole 4, kidole chako kidogo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Oktava mbili, G hadi G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.translation: Wimbo wa Krismasi kwenye skeli
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, iliyopangwa na Lowell Mason mwaka 1839, huanza kwa skeli ya G meja ikishuka moja kwa moja kutoka juu. Tayari unajua kila noti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World, mkono sehemu moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Madaraja ya skeli na kodi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title

rows.translation: Zipe noti namba
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Hesabu skeli kutoka G: G ni 1, A ni 2, na kuendelea hadi F diesi, 7. Wanamuziki hutumia namba hizi kuzungumzia melodi na kodi katika ufunguo wowote.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, noti ipi ni 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Hesabu ukipanda kutoka G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi kwenye kila noti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Jenga kodi kwenye kila daraja kwa kuruka noti moja moja ya skeli upate kodi za ufunguo huo. Kodi za 1, 4 na 5 ni meja; za 2, 3 na 6 ni minori. Katika G: G, C na D, kisha A minori, B minori na E minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ipi hujengwa kwenye 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Noti ya sita ni E, na kodi za 2, 3 na 6 ni minori. Unganisha E, G na B: E minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli kwa miruko ya tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti zilezile, msingi mpya
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Piga noti za G meja lakini ufanye A kuwa msingi, na skeli itakuwa minori. Sauti hii ni A Dorian, modi ya G meja: nafasi ileile, noti mpya ya kuanzia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Anza kwenye A, uzi 6, freti 5, kwa kidole 4, na upande freti zilezile hadi A kwenye uzi 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Noti gani hufanya A Dorian iwe angavu kuliko A minori ya kawaida?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: F diesi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: A minori ya kawaida ina F. Dorian hubaki na F diesi ya G meja: mwangaza katika skeli minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodi ya A Dorian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodi ya A Dorian, kwa mtiririko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Anza kwenye D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Sasa fanya D kuwa msingi. Noti za G meja kutoka D hadi D huunda D Mixolydian: skeli meja yenye noti ya saba freti moja chini. Inatumika sana katika folk, rock na melodi za fiddle.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Kutoka D kwenye uzi 5, freti 5, panda katika nafasi ileile hadi D kwenye uzi 2, freti 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D meja ina C diesi. D Mixolydian ina…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Mixolydian hushusha noti ya saba kwa freti moja, kwa hiyo C ya G meja ndiyo huipa ladha yake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodi ya D Mixolydian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Modi moja moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Noti yoyote ya skeli meja inaweza kuwa msingi. Kutoka G ni meja, kutoka A ni Dorian, kutoka D ni Mixolydian, kutoka E ni minori ya kawaida. Freti zilezile, hisia tofauti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: D Mixolydian, mara mbili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Market Day
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · title

rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia nafasi ya pili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Market Day ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: pop changamfu katika G yenye mwendo wa highlife, muziki angavu wa gitaa wa Afrika Magharibi. Kishazi chake cha kuvutia hutumia noti za G meja tu, ndani ya skeli yako ya nafasi ya pili. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Kodi za Market Day ni G, B minori, C na D. Ziko kwenye madaraja gani ya skeli?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G ni 1, B ni 3, C ni 4 na D ni 5. Kodi kwenye 3 ni minori katika kila ufunguo meja: B minori.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D freti 3 uzi 2, B freti 4 uzi 3, D tena, E freti 5 kwa kidole 4, kisha D na B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Jaribio la skeli
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · title

rows.translation: Nafasi moja, hisia tatu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: G meja kwa oktava mbili, skeli kwa miruko ya tatu, A Dorian na D Mixolydian. Kidole kimoja kwa kila freti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu huunda…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Skeli ya meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Pentatoniki minori
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Modi gani huanza kwenye noti ya pili ya G meja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · challenge gtr-20-6 “Scale challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja na solo yenye hisia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · title

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja, hammer-on na slide za country, trili, upangaji wa vishazi, na utamu na ukakasi katika blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 “Major pentatonic and expressive lead” · unit summary

rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · title

rows.translation: Hamisha umbo chini
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo lako la pentatoniki minori kutoka freti 5 hadi freti 2 chini na ufanye A kuwa msingi: litakuwa tamu na la meja. Hiyo ni pentatoniki ya A meja: A, B, C diesi, E na F diesi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Kutoka A kwenye uzi 6, freti 5, kisha freti 2 na 4 kwenye nyuzi 5 na 4, na A freti 2 kwenye uzi 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi ziko katika pentatoniki ya A meja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C diesi, E, F diesi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Noti tano za skeli ya A meja, nusu toni zake mbili zimeachwa. Umbo minori freti 5 lina A, C, D, E na G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.translation: Pentatoniki ya A meja, panda na ushuke
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Umbo moja, funguo mbili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Umbo hili freti 2 pia ni pentatoniki ya F diesi minori, kuanzia F diesi yake. Noti unayoifanya kuwa msingi ndiyo huamua skeli unayopiga.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kishazi kitamu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Hammer-on na slide za country
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · title

rows.translation: Hammer-on kuelekea meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Wapigaji wa country hupenda hammer-on ndani ya umbo hili: E hadi F diesi kwenye uzi 4, A hadi B kwenye uzi 3. Piga noti ya kwanza, kisha fanya hammer-on kwa ya pili.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 4: piga freti 2, kisha tushia kidole 3 kwenye freti 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kishazi 1: hammer-on mbili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Teleza juu hadi C diesi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Sasa telezesha kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3 kutoka freti 4 hadi freti 6, B kupanda hadi C diesi, kisha teleza urudi ndani ya umbo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Kidole 3 kwenye uzi 3, freti 4. Piga uzi, kisha teleza hadi freti 6 bila kuinua.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kishazi 2: slide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vishazi vyote viwili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Trili na slide kuelekea noti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · title

rows.translation: Trili
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trili hupokezana haraka kati ya noti mbili: piga uzi mara moja, kisha hammer-on, pull-off, tena na tena. Dumisha mwendo sawa kabla ya kuongeza kasi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 3: freti 2 na 4. Piga mara moja, kisha fanya hammer-on na pull-off kwa kidole 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Trili ya polepole
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Trili kwenye nyuzi 3 na 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Teleza kuingia kwenye noti
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Anza freti moja chini ya noti unayotaka na uteleze juu kuifikia unapopiga. Noti lengwa ndiyo muhimu: tua hapo hasa kwenye pigo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Unapoteleza kuingia kwenye noti, ipi hutua kwenye pigo?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti lengwa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti iliyo chini yake
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Zote mbili pamoja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Slide huanza kabla kidogo ya pigo ili noti unayolenga ifike hasa kwenye pigo hilo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Teleza kuingia kila kishazi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Utamu na ukakasi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · title

rows.translation: Maumbo mawili, blues moja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Katika blues ya A, maumbo yote mawili yanafaa. Pentatoniki meja freti 2 husikika tamu; minori freti 5 husikika kali. Wapigaji wazuri huhama kati yake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Utamu, kwenye freti 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Ukakasi, kwenye freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Umbo lipi husikika tamu zaidi likipigwa pamoja na A7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A meja, kwenye freti 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A minori, kwenye freti 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Pentatoniki meja ina C diesi, noti ya tatu ya A7. C ya umbo minori huleta mvutano dhidi yake, na mvutano huo ndio blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ukakasi, kisha utamu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Uliza swali kali freti 5, kisha lijibu kwa utamu freti 2. Hamisha mkono kwenye noti ndefu, na umalizie vishazi vyote viwili kwenye A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Swali na jibu, kwa mtiririko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Panga vishazi kama mwimbaji
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · title

rows.translation: Acha nafasi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Solo nzuri hupumua. Piga kishazi kifupi, pumzika kwa muda unaokaribia uleule, kisha jibu. Kimya huzipa noti zinazofuata umuhimu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Vishazi na mapumziko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Baada ya kishazi cha mapigo mawili, unaweza kupumzika kwa muda gani?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Usipumzike: endelea kupiga
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Karibu muda uleule tena
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kipimo kizima kila wakati
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Rudia, kisha badili mwisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Piga kishazi mara mbili kwa namna ileile, kisha badili mwisho wake tu. Wasikilizaji husikia mrudio na kusikiliza kwa makini mabadiliko.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rudia na ubadilishe
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vibrato kwenye noti ndefu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Shikilia kila noti ndefu na uibembeze kwa kusukuma na kuachia kidogo kwa mwendo sawa. Mwendo uwe mdogo: kimo cha sauti kitetereke, kisipotee.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Rudia na ubadilishe, kwa vibrato
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo maalumu: Slow Motion Strobe
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · title

rows.translation: Umbo moja, mzunguko mzima
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: synth-pop katika A kwa F diesi minori, D, A na E. Umbo lako freti 2 linafaa mzunguko mzima: pentatoniki ya A meja, ambayo pia ni ya F diesi minori. Wimbo mzima uko kwenye Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Sikiliza kodi ya kwanza. Meja au minori?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Kwa F diesi minori na D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kwa A na E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Ni noti zipi za umbo hili zilizo sehemu ya kodi E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E na B
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C diesi na F diesi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A na C diesi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E ni E, G diesi na B. Umbo lina E na B lakini halina G diesi, kwa hiyo kazia hizo mbili unapopiga pamoja na E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Solo yako juu ya mzunguko
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Jaribio la solo yenye hisia
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · title

rows.translation: Utamu, ukakasi na kuimba
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Hakuna jipya: pentatoniki meja, hammer-on, slide, trili na maumbo yote mawili katika blues. Acha nafasi, na umalizie kwenye A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Hamisha umbo minori kutoka freti 5 hadi freti 2 nalo hupiga…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pentatoniki ya D minori
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Pentatoniki ya A meja
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · challenge gtr-21-6 “Expressive lead challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Muundo na upangaji wa nyimbo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 “Song form and arranging” · title

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Ubeti, kiitikio na AABA, utangulizi na miisho, muundo wa sauti na fill, na mpangilio wako wa Down by the Riverside.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 “Song form and arranging” · unit summary

rows.translation: Jinsi nyimbo hujengwa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · title

rows.translation: Sehemu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi hujengwa kwa sehemu chache: beti zinazosimulia, kiitikio kinachorudia kishazi cha kuvutia, na wakati mwingine daraja la kuleta tofauti. Kujua mpangilio hukuzuia kupotea.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.translation: Kiitikio kwa kawaida hubeba nini?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kishazi cha kuvutia wanachoimba wote
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Solo ya gitaa
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Kiitikio hurudi na maneno na melodi zilezile. Ndicho watu hukumbuka na kuimba pamoja nacho.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi za zamani hutumia AABA: melodi, melodi ileile tena, daraja tofauti, kisha melodi mara nyingine. Kila sehemu mara nyingi huwa vipimo vinane; hapa ni vinne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Katika muundo wa AABA, sehemu gani ni daraja?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: A ya kwanza
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sehemu B
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A ya mwisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Utangulizi na miisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · title

rows.translation: Kopa mstari wa mwisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Utangulizi rahisi zaidi ni mstari wa mwisho wa wimbo, ukipigwa kabla ya ubeti wa kwanza. Huanzisha ufunguo, tempo na hisia, na mwimbaji hujua hasa pa kuingia.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An intro from the last line
rows.translation: Utangulizi kutoka mstari wa mwisho
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Why start with the song's last line?
rows.translation: Kwa nini uanze na mstari wa mwisho wa wimbo?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ndiyo sehemu ngumu zaidi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Huchukua nafasi ya kiitikio
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It sets the key and tempo
rows.translation: Huanzisha ufunguo na tempo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mwisho

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: mpangilio wako
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, wimbo wa kiroho uliochapishwa kwanza mwaka 1918, hupata mpangilio kamili: utangulizi kwa Travis, beti na viitikio viwili, solo ya pentatoniki, na mrudio wa mwisho.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Solo hutumia pentatoniki ya G meja katika nafasi ya wazi: G, A, B, D na E. Hufuata kodi za ubeti na huisha pigo moja mapema ili mwimbaji aweze kurudi.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon ni wimbo asilia wa Timbre: dansi ya polepole ya miaka ya hamsini kwa AABA, ubeti, ubeti tena, daraja kwa F, kisha ubeti mara nyingine. Piga kila pigo, ukiweka pigo la juu la haraka la swing kuelekea kila kipimo kipya. Wimbo mzima uko Nyimbo, chini ya Nyimbo asilia.

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Kwa ala nyingi, ukisogea juu kutoka uzi mmoja hadi mwingine, sauti huzidi kuwa ya chini. Kwa ukulele, uzi 4 (G) una sauti ya juu kuliko uzi 3 (C). Huu huitwa upangaji wa sauti wa re-entrant.

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: G ya juu huweka noti za kila kodi karibu na kuifanya iwe angavu. Ndiyo sauti tamu inayolia ambayo watu huitambua kuwa ya ukulele.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat inahitaji C tu. Piga kodi hiyo kwenye mapigo mawili makuu ya kila kipimo, kisha piga melodi kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Noti tano za melodi: C na D kwenye uzi 3, E, F na G kwenye uzi 2.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Muziki wa kati
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Ya jadi (1852)
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A minori, F, G7 na G: pamoja na C, kodi zinazotumika katika nyimbo nyingi sana.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 “First chords” · unit summary

rows.source: A minor and your first change
rows.translation: A minori na badiliko lako la kwanza
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · title

rows.translation: A minori: kidole kimoja tena
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Weka kidole cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4 na upige nyuzi zote nne. A minori husikika yenye giza zaidi kuliko C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi ipi husikika yenye giza zaidi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Badili mapema, usichelewe
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Inua kidole usichohitaji na uweke kipya wakati mpigo wa mwisho bado unalia. Tazama kodi inayofuata mapema.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: F: vidole viwili
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · title

rows.translation: F hutumia vidole viwili
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4. Nyuzi 3 na 1 hulia wazi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hushiriki kidole na F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Hakuna kati ya hizo
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Kidole chako cha pili kiko kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4 kwa zote mbili. Kibakize chini unapobadili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
rows.translation: G7, kodi inayoongoza kwenye msingi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · title

rows.translation: G7: pembetatu ya vidole
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 2, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha tatu freti 2 ya uzi 1. Piga nyuzi zote nne.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
rows.translation: Kodi inayotaka kurudi kwenye msingi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 husikika haijakamilika. Piga C baada yake na mvutano utaisha. Mvuto huo ndio hufanya nyimbo nyingi ziweke G7 kabla ya C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Hii inaishia kwenye msingi au inaacha mvutano?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye msingi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Inaacha mvutano
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G: vidole vitatu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 1, cha tatu freti 3 ya uzi 2. Pinda vidole ili uzi 4 ulie.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: G na G7 zote hubonyeza sehemu gani?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Freti 1 ya uzi 2
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti 3 ya uzi 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Freti 2 ya uzi 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Kodi zote mbili huweka kidole kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 3. Kitumie kama nanga yako.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Ipi ni G7, yenye mvutano zaidi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Jaribio: kodi tano
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · title

rows.translation: Kodi tano, mkono mmoja
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A minori, F, G7 na G hutumika katika mamia ya nyimbo. Fanya kila umbo litoe sauti safi, kisha dumisha mapigo unapobadili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi hutumia kidole kimoja tu?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya chini thabiti, chini-juu na mpigo wa visiwani.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 “Strumming” · unit summary

rows.translation: Mapigo ya nyuzi chini kwa uthabiti
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · title

rows.translation: Mkono wako ni saa
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Piga nyuzi chini kwa kila pigo: 1, 2, 3, 4. Tumia ukucha wa shahada. Unapobadili kodi, mkono unaendelea kusogea.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Mkono ufanye nini unapobadili kodi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Dumisha mapigo
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Simama na usubiri
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ongeza kasi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Kodi iliyochelewa ni bora kuliko kupoteza mapigo. Endelea kupiga nyuzi, hata uzi ukikwaruza.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapigo ya juu yako kati ya mapigo
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Hesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na. Piga chini kwenye namba, juu kwenye kila na. Mkono hauachi kusogea.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Upole zaidi unapopanda
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya juu hugusa hasa nyuzi 1 na 2. Zipige kwa sehemu laini ya kidole, kwa upole kidogo kuliko mapigo ya chini.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mapigo ya nyuzi juu huja lini?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye na kati ya mapigo
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye mapigo 1 na 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
rows.translation: Mwishoni mwa kipimo tu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Chini, chini-juu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · title

rows.translation: Acha nafasi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye 1, chini-juu kwenye 2, chini kwenye 3, chini-juu kwenye 4. Mkono bado hupanda baada ya 1 na 3; hauzigusi tu nyuzi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.translation: Mkono hufanya nini kwenye na ya 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Unapanda bila kugusa nyuzi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Unasimama
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Unapiga juu kwa nguvu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Mwendo wa juu usio na sauti hudumisha muda wa mkono kwa pigo la chini linalofuata.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mpigo wa visiwani
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · title

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Chini kwenye 1, chini-juu kwenye 2, ruka chini kwenye 3, kisha juu, chini-juu. Pigo la chini linalokosekana huleta mwendo wa kubembea.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Unaruka pigo gani katika mpigo wa visiwani?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: La chini kwenye 1
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La juu baada ya 4
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: La chini kwenye 3
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Mkono bado hushuka kwenye 3, lakini haugusi nyuzi. Hivyo pigo la juu linalofuata linabaki kwa wakati.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mpigo wa visiwani na kubadili kodi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · title

rows.translation: Badili kwenye pigo la mwisho la juu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Pigo la mwisho la juu la kipimo linaweza kuwa legevu au la nyuzi wazi. Litumie kuhamia kodi inayofuata ili pigo 1 litue kwa usafi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Jaribio: mipangilio ya kupiga nyuzi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · title

rows.translation: Mipangilio mitatu, kodi tano
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya chini, chini-juu na mpigo wa visiwani. Endelea kusogeza mkono na uache kodi zije zenyewe.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.translation: Mpangilio upi ni mpigo wa visiwani?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Melodi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · title

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Piga melodi noti kwa noti kwenye nyuzi 1 hadi 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · unit summary

rows.translation: Noti nane, nyuzi tatu
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Anza kwenye uzi 3 wazi na upande kupitia nyuzi 2 na 1. Kila noti iko katika freti tatu za kwanza.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi na freti 2, kisha uzi 2 wazi na freti 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 freti 3, kisha uzi 1: wazi, freti 2, freti 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Kuna majina mangapi tofauti ya noti katika skeli?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: C hadi C ni noti nane, lakini C ya juu hurudia ya kwanza. Majina saba, kisha huanza tena.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodi unayoijua tayari
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven aliandika melodi hii mwaka 1824. Kwa kawaida husogea kwa hatua, kutoka noti moja hadi inayofuata, kwenye nyuzi 2 na 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Mwanzo: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Ode to Joy, mstari wa kwanza
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Mstari wa kwanza huishia D. Wa pili huishia wapi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye C, msingi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye D tena
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Mwanzo uleule, mwisho tofauti. Mstari wa pili hurudi kwenye C msingi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ode to Joy, mstari wa pili
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mruko, kisha hatua za kushuka
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya jadi huruka kutoka C hadi G juu, kisha hushuka noti moja moja. Kila mstari huishia kwa noti ndefu zaidi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi, uzi 2 freti 3, uzi 1 wazi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Kishazi hiki hupanda au hushuka?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mstari wa kati
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti ndefu na noti fupi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · title

rows.translation: Noti zina urefu wa muda
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja, noti nusu mawili, noti nzima manne. Shikilia kila moja hadi noti inayofuata ianze.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Shikilia
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Nukta
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Nukta huongeza nusu ya muda wa noti. Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu mapigo matatu; noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu mapigo mangapi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Wimbo wa mapenzi wa polepole wa 1861
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: “Aura Lee” ilichapishwa mwaka 1861, muziki wake ukiwa wa George R. Poulton. Piga polepole na uache kila noti ilie hadi inayofuata.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti mpya: F diesi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili kwenye freti 2 ya uzi 4, cha kwanza freti 1 ya uzi 3. Nyuzi 2 na 1 hulia wazi.

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi ina vidole vitatu kwenye freti moja?

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye freti 1 ya uzi 4, cha pili freti 2 ya uzi 3, cha tatu freti 2 ya uzi 1. Uzi 2 hulia wazi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi nyingine yenye mvuto
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 huvuta kuelekea C. Vivyo hivyo, E7 huvuta kuelekea A minori. Zipige moja baada ya nyingine na usikilize mvutano unavyoisha.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kodi nne, nyimbo zisizoisha
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · title

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Zipe noti za skeli ya C namba uweze kutaja kodi kwa namba: C ni I, G ni V, A minori ni vi, F ni IV. Mpangilio huu hupatikana katika nyimbo nyingi sana.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Hesabu skeli ukipanda kutoka C: C, D, E, F. F ni noti ya nne, kwa hiyo F ndiyo kodi IV.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi ni vi katika C?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Namba za Kirumi za herufi ndogo humaanisha kodi minori. Noti ya sita ya C meja ni A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio: kodi kumi

rows.translation: Sasa kodi kumi
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A minori, F, G, G7, D minori, E minori, D, A na E7. Maumbo safi kwanza, kisha mapigo thabiti ya nyuzi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa C, kodi ipi ni V?
