rows.context: Bass · Unit 4 · challenge bass-4-5 “Challenge: outline the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The 12-bar blues, walking lines and chromatic approach notes.
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12, mistari ya walking bass na noti za kukaribia za kromatiki.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 “Walking bass” · unit summary

rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · title

rows.translation: Vipimo kumi na viwili, kodi tatu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: Blues hurudia mzunguko wa vipimo 12: vipimo vinne vya A, viwili vya D, viwili vya A, kisha E, D, A, E. Hesabu vipimo ili ujue ulipo wakati wote.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huanza na vipimo vingapi vya A?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti msingi za vipimo 12 katika A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kodi ipi inakuja katika kipimo 9?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: Vipimo 9 hadi 12 ni E, D, A, E. E katika kipimo 12 hurudisha mzunguko mwanzo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti msingi na ya tano, vipimo 12
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-1 “The 12-bar blues” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kupanda kodi kwa walking bass
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · title

rows.source: A new note on every beat
rows.translation: Noti mpya kwenye kila pigo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
rows.translation: Mstari wa walking bass hupiga noti mpya kwenye kila pigo. Anza na noti msingi, ya tatu, ya tano, ya sita: katika A ni A, C diesi, E, F diesi.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 wazi, freti 4; kisha uzi 2, freti 2 na 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Walking bass katika A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: What makes a bass line walk?
rows.translation: Nini huufanya mstari wa besi uwe walking bass?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti msingi zinazoshikiliwa kwa muda mrefu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Nyuzi wazi tu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Uzi 2 wazi, freti 4; kisha uzi 1, freti 2 na 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Walking bass katika D na E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-2 “Walking up the chord” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti za kukaribia za kromatiki
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · title

rows.translation: Elekea kwenye kodi inayofuata
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Kwenye pigo 4, piga noti iliyo freti moja kutoka noti msingi inayofuata. Huvutia sikio mbele, hivyo badiliko husikika kama limefika lengoni.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 freti 4, kisha uzi 2 wazi: freti moja juu kuingia D.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: Unaelekea D katika kipimo kinachofuata. Noti ipi kwenye pigo 4 huvutia zaidi?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: C diesi iko freti moja chini ya D. Nusu toni huingia moja kwa moja kwenye noti msingi mpya.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Walking bass kuelekea D na kurudi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Zimetengana kwa freti moja au zaidi?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Zaidi ya moja
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Karibia kila badiliko
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Blues ya walking bass katika A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · title

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.translation: Tumia walking bass kwenye muundo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Vipimo 12 vilevile, sasa vikiwa na mstari wa walking bass. Vipimo vinavyoelekea kodi mpya huisha kwa noti ya kukaribia.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Vipimo 1 hadi 4
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vipimo 5 hadi 8
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vipimo 9 hadi 12
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.translation: Kwa nini kipimo 12 kinaishia kwenye G diesi?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ni noti msingi ya E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Inaongoza kurudi A mwanzoni
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Inamaliza wimbo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Kipimo 12 hurudisha muundo mwanzo. G diesi iko freti moja chini ya A, kodi inayoanza mzunguko unaofuata.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Walking blues katika A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Changamoto: walking blues katika E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · title

rows.translation: Muundo uleule, ufunguo mpya
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 hufaa katika ufunguo wowote. Katika E, kodi ni E, A na B. Tumia walking bass yenye noti msingi, za tatu, tano na sita, ukikaribia kila badiliko.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa E, kodi ipi inakuja kwenye kipimo 9?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: Uzi 3 freti 2; uzi 2 freti 1 na 4; uzi 1 freti 1.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Vipimo 1 hadi 6
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Vipimo 7 hadi 12
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Walking blues katika E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Midundo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · title

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Rock ya noti za nane, midundo yenye nukta, nafasi, na mstari wa mtindo wa Motown.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary

rows.translation: Mdundo wa rock wa noti za nane
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · title

rows.translation: Noti nane zilizo sawa
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Hesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na. Piga noti kwenye kila hesabu ukibadilishana vidole. Lengo ni sauti yenye ukubwa ulio sawa.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti za nane kwenye E na A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Noti zako za nane zinaanza kuharakisha. Nini kitasaidia?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Piga kwa sauti kubwa zaidi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.translation: Fuata mlio na ulegeze mkono
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tumia kidole kimoja tu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mdundo wa rock katika E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Midundo yenye nukta
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu. Piga kwenye 1, shikilia kupitia 2, kisha piga kwenye na ya 2, halafu kwenye 3 na 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Ndefu-fupi kwenye A, D na E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu kwa muda gani?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pigo moja na nusu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tatu, tatu, mbili
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Acha nafasi kidogo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · title

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.translation: Ukimya ni sehemu ya mdundo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Noti fupi zenye mapumziko safi hufanya mstari uchangamke. Punguza mgandamizo wa kidole cha freti huku bado ukigusa uzi, ili kusimamisha kila noti kwa wakati sahihi.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Fupi na zenye mruko
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.translation: Unasimamishaje noti ya freti kwa usafi?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Iache isikike hadi iishe
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Piga uzi unaofuata
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.translation: Punguza mgandamizo lakini endelea kuugusa
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Punguza mgandamizo huku kidole kikibaki juu ya uzi. Noti itanyamaza bila mlio wa kukwaruza.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mstari wa mtindo wa Motown
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · title

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.translation: Noti nyingi, lakini kwa muda sahihi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Mistari ya besi ya enzi za Motown ilisogea sana: noti za kodi, noti za kuelekea kodi inayofuata, na mikazo kati ya mapigo. Mstari huu ni mpya, umetungwa kwa mtindo huo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Kipimo cha kwanza: C, E, G, kisha B bemoli ikielekea A.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Vipimo 3 na 4
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: B bemoli hufanya nini mwishoni mwa kipimo 1?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Hurudia noti msingi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Huelekeza freti moja chini kwenda A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Humaliza mstari
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: Ni noti ya kukaribia, freti moja juu ya A, noti msingi ya kodi inayofuata. Inakuingiza katika kipimo kinachofuata.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mstari kwa mtindo wa Motown
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.translation: Changamoto: mkusanyiko wa midundo
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · title

rows.translation: Midundo mitatu, muda sahihi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Noti za nane, midundo yenye nukta na mstari unaosogea. Fuata mlio wa metronomu, endelea kubadilishana vidole na ufurahie mdundo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Katika mdundo wa noti za nane, hesabu zipi zina noti?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Namba tu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapigo 1 na 3 tu
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kila namba na kila na
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Violini
rows.context: Violin course · title

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Piga kwa upinde na vidole kwa usahihi, kutoka nyuzi wazi hadi nyimbo za jadi
rows.context: Violin course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hujambo, violini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Ishike, piga kwa upinde, rekebisha sauti, piga nyuzi wazi na wimbo wako wa kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary

rows.translation: Fahamu violini yako
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title

rows.translation: Nyuzi nne, sauti za chini hadi juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Violini ikiwa chini ya kidevu, nyuzi ni G, D, A, E kutoka kushoto kwenda kulia. G ni mnene zaidi na ya sauti ya chini zaidi. E ni mwembamba zaidi na ya sauti ya juu zaidi; tunauita uzi 1.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Daraja la nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Daraja la nyuzi ni kipande chembamba cha mbao chenye upinde kinachoinua nyuzi. Nguvu ya nyuzi pekee ndiyo hukishikilia. Kikianza kuinama, mwombe mwalimu au fundi akisimamishe vizuri.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Uzi upi una sauti ya juu zaidi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E ni uzi mwembamba zaidi na wenye sauti ya juu zaidi. Nyuzi huhesabiwa kutoka E (1) hadi G (4).
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Anza kwa kupiga kwa kidole
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Kabla ya kutumia upinde, piga kwa kidole. Egemeza gumba la kulia ubavuni mwa ubao wa vidole na uvute uzi kwa kidole cha kwanza. Wapigaji huita hii pizzicato.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Laza violini mapajani kama gitaa dogo. Piga uzi 2, yaani A, kwa kidole na uache usikike.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sasa uzi 1, yaani E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi mnene zaidi, yaani G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Shika violini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title

rows.translation: Mtulinga na egemeo la kidevu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Weka ukingo wa chini wa violini kwenye mtulinga wa kushoto, kisha geuza kichwa uweke taya kwenye egemeo la kidevu. Uzito wa kichwa ndio huishikilia. Usiibane.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mkono wa kushoto usiobana
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Elekeza kichwa kilichoviringika mbele na kushoto, violini ikiwa karibu mlalo, sambamba na sakafu. Mkono wa kushoto ushike shingo kwa upole, gumba likiwa mkabala na kidole cha kwanza. Kifundo kiwe kimenyooka na kimelegea.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nini huishikilia violini juu?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.translation: Mtulinga na uzito wa kichwa chako
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mkono wa kushoto unaobana sana
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Bega lako lililoinuliwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Acha kichwa kipumzike kwenye egemeo la kidevu. Mkono unaobana au bega lililoinuliwa hukukaza, na mkazo huo hufanya noti zisikike nje ya sauti sahihi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Shikilia violini mahali pake na upige uzi wa D, uzi 3, kwa kidole.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Piga kwa kidole pamoja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Shika upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title

rows.translation: Sehemu za upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Fimbo ya mbao hutoka frog, sehemu ya kushikia, hadi nchani. Nywele za farasi zimetandazwa kati yake. Kaza skrubu hadi penseli iweze kutoshea tu kati ya nywele na fimbo.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Shika upinde kwa mkono uliolegea
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Pinda gumba, uweke ncha yake panapokutana frog na fimbo. Tandaza vidole juu ya fimbo, kidole kidogo kikiwa kimepinda na kusimama juu yake. Mkono wote ubaki umelegea.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Gumba lako hukaa wapi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Limepinda, panapokutana frog na fimbo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Limenyooka, chini ya nywele
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.translation: Limelala juu ya fimbo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Gumba lililopinda kwenye frog huacha mkono umelegea na kusaidia kuusawazisha upinde.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rosini huleta sauti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Nywele tupu huteleza juu ya uzi bila sauti. Paka kipande cha rosini kwenye nywele mara chache kabla ya kupiga. Tabaka jembamba linatosha.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Weka upinde kwenye uzi wa A, katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Uvute polepole kwenda kulia.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi wa D. Inua kiwiko kidogo, kisha uvute polepole.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mipigo mirefu ya upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu: G, D, A, E. Kila uzi uko majina matano ya herufi juu ya uliotangulia; umbali huo huitwa wa tano. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kimo kimoja kwa kila uzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Kiwiko cha kulia huamua upinde utapiga uzi upi. Kiinue kwa G, kishushe kwa E. Kila uzi una kimo chake, kama ngazi za kupandia.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Piga uzi wa G kwa upinde, kisha D. Kiwiko huwa juu zaidi kwa G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Sasa A, kisha E. Shusha kiwiko hatua moja kwa kila uzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.translation: Uzi upi unahitaji kiwiko kiwe juu zaidi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: Uzi wa G uko kushoto zaidi, kwa hiyo mkono huinuka kuufikia. E inahitaji mkono uwe chini zaidi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rekebisha sauti ya violini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title

rows.translation: Rekebisha A kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Okestra hurekebisha sauti kwa A. Timbre huonyesha kwa senti jinsi kila uzi ulivyo mbali na noti yake; senti 100 ni nusu toni, hatua ndogo zaidi kwenye piano. Rekebisha A, kisha D, G na E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Virekebishi vidogo kwa mabadiliko madogo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Skrubu ndogo kwenye kishikio cha nyuzi ni virekebishi vidogo. Zungusha kimoja kulia kuinua kimo cha sauti, kushoto kukishusha. Robo ya mzunguko inatosha.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Sauti ya uzi iko chini kidogo. Ufanye nini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Zungusha kirekebishi chake kidogo kulia
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Zungusha kirekebishi chake kidogo kushoto
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sukuma daraja la nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Kuwa chini maana yake sauti iko chini kuliko inavyotakiwa. Kuzungusha kulia hukaza uzi na kuinua kimo cha sauti.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Vigingi kwa mabadiliko makubwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Kirekebishi kidogo kikifika mwisho, tumia kigingi. Kizungushe kidogo huku ukikisukuma ndani ili kishike. Uzi ukiwa mbali sana na sauti yake, mwombe mwalimu akusaidie; vigingi vinaweza kuteleza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Rekebisha uzi wa A, kisha upige kwa upinde na udumishe sauti thabiti.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Sasa D, G na E. Rekebisha kila uzi, kisha upige kwa upinde na ushikilie sauti.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Jaribio la nyuzi wazi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title

rows.translation: Kagua maandalizi yako
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Violini kwenye mtulinga, shikilia upinde kwa upole, upinde uwe katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Sasa piga yote uliyojifunza katika kitengo hiki.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Uzi 3 ni upi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Piga kila uzi wazi kwa upinde kutoka sauti ya juu hadi chini. Dumisha sauti thabiti kwa kila uzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.translation: Unarekebisha uzi upi kwanza?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Okestra hurekebisha sauti kwa A, kwa hiyo anza hapo, kisha rekebisha mingine.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kupanda na kushuka ngazi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb uko kwenye uzi wa A: A wazi, kidole cha kwanza toni nzima juu kwa B, cha pili toni nyingine nzima juu kwa C diesi. Piga kwanza kwa kidole, kisha kwa upinde.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa A, toni nzima juu. Hiyo ni B.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili toni nzima juu ya cha kwanza. Hiyo ni C diesi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: C diesi, B, A, B, kisha C diesi mara tatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kupiga kwa upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Mipigo mirefu sawa ya upinde, kuvuka nyuzi kwa usafi na midundo yako ya kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary

rows.translation: Upinde: pigo chini, pigo juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title

rows.translation: Pande mbili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Pigo chini huvuta upinde kulia, kutoka frog hadi ncha. Pigo juu huusukuma kurudi kushoto. Kwenye noti, alama ya pigo chini hufanana na meza ndogo, na ya pigo juu na V.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: Pigo chini husogeza upinde kuelekea wapi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kutoka frog kuelekea ncha
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kutoka ncha kuelekea frog
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kuelekea daraja la nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mahali pa mguso
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Piga katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na mwisho wa ubao wa vidole. Weka upinde sambamba na daraja, kama treni kwenye reli yake.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Pigo moja la chini polepole, kisha la juu polepole kwenye A. Sauti ibaki sawa hadi mwisho.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Upinde mzima kwenye A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Upinde mzima kwenye kila uzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti robo, noti nusu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title

rows.translation: Noti robo, nusu ya upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja. Noti za haraka huhitaji upinde kidogo, kwa hiyo tumia nusu ya katikati ya upinde, kila mpigo ukiwa na urefu uleule.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti robo kwenye A na D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti nusu, upinde polepole zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Noti nusu hudumu mapigo mawili. Tumia mwendo mrefu zaidi na wa polepole zaidi wa upinde ili sauti isipungue kwenye pigo la pili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti ipi inahitaji upinde mwingi zaidi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti nusu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti robo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Zinahitaji kiasi kilekile
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Noti nusu hudumu mara mbili zaidi, kwa hiyo inapata mwendo mrefu zaidi na wa polepole zaidi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Fupi, fupi, ndefu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kuvuka nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title

rows.translation: Sogeza kuanzia kiwikoni
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Kuvuka nyuzi, badili kimo kwa kiwiko, si kifundo cha mkono. Fikia kimo kipya muda mfupi kabla upinde haujageuka.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Acha kiwiko kibadilishane kati ya vimo viwili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kuyumba kati ya nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Nini husogeza upinde kwenye uzi mpya?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kiwiko chako, kikibadili kimo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Vidole vyako, vikibana
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kuinamisha violini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kuruka uzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Kutoka G kwenda A huruka uzi wa D, hivyo kiwiko hufanya mwendo mkubwa zaidi. Sogea taratibu bila kukwama na usiache uzi wa katikati usikike.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Zote nne, kupanda na kurudi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti za nane
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title

rows.translation: Noti mbili kwa kila pigo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane hudumu nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hutimia katika kila pigo. Tumia mipigo mifupi ya haraka karibu na katikati ya upinde.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Haraka-haraka, polepole
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za nane hutimia katika pigo moja?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ndefu, fupi-fupi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Sasa changanya: noti robo, mbili za nane, kisha robo mbili. Wapiga violini wa jadi hutumia sana mdundo huu. Useme kwanza: ndefu, fupi-fupi, ndefu, ndefu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Jaribio la kupiga kwa upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title

rows.translation: Upinde na midundo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Mipigo ya upinde iliyonyooka mahali pa mguso, kuvuka nyuzi kwa kuongozwa na kiwiko, na midundo thabiti. Huu hapa mchanganyiko wa yote matatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mahali pa mguso ni wapi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Katikati ya daraja na ubao wa vidole
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.translation: Juu ya daraja la nyuzi kabisa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.translation: Juu ya mwisho wa ubao wa vidole

rows.translation: Mazoezi ya mwanzo ya kuvuka nyuzi

rows.translation: Nusu ya pigo

rows.translation: Mdundo wa nyuzi wazi

rows.translation: Vidole vya kwanza: A na E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Weka vidole 1, 2 na 3, piga skeli ya A meja na wimbo wako wa kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza: B
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title

rows.translation: Hakuna freti, masikio tu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Ala yako haina freti, kwa hiyo sikio lako ndilo huweka kila noti. Wapigaji wengi hubandika utepe mwembamba kwenye ubao wa vidole kuwaongoza wanapojifunza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Weka ncha ya kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa A, kwenye utepe wa kwanza. Hiyo ni B, toni nzima juu ya A; toni nzima ni nusu toni mbili. Bonyeza hadi uzi uguse ubao wa vidole.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: A wazi, kisha B kwa kidole cha kwanza. Shikilia B hadi itulie kwenye sauti sahihi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Juu au chini mno? Sogeza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre hukubali noti iliyo ndani ya senti 30, karibu theluthi ya nusu toni. Sauti ikiwa juu mno, sogeza kidole kidogo kuelekea kichwani. Ikiwa chini mno, kisogeze kuelekea daraja la nyuzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, A wazi, B. Inua kidole na ukirudishe mahali palepale.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: A wazi, kisha B. Zimetengana kwa kiasi gani?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Toni nzima
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Nusu toni
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: A na B
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha pili: C diesi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title

rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili hupiga C diesi, toni nzima juu ya B, kwa hiyo acha nafasi baada ya kidole cha kwanza. Nafasi hii huitwa kidole 2 juu, kwa sababu iko karibu na mahali kitakapowekwa cha tatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, C diesi. Acha kidole cha kwanza chini cha pili kinapopiga.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kutoka B hadi noti inayofuata: ni hatua ya aina gani?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: C diesi iko umbali gani juu ya B?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Toni nzima mbili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: B hadi C diesi ni nusu toni mbili, kwa hiyo kidole cha pili huacha nafasi baada ya cha kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, C diesi, B, A. Fikia sauti sahihi kwa kila noti kabla ya kuendelea.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu: D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hugusa cha pili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hupiga D, nusu toni juu ya C diesi, kwa hiyo hukaa karibu kabisa na cha pili. Kwenye uzi wa A mpangilio ni 1, kisha 2 na 3 pamoja.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, C diesi, D. Acha kila kidole chini unapoongeza kinachofuata.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: D yako inapokuwa sahihi, uzi wa D wazi hutetemeka pamoja nayo. Zina jina lilelile la herufi, zikitengana kwa noti nane: oktava. Sikiliza violini ikitoa sauti iliyojaa zaidi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D ya kidole cha tatu, D wazi, kisha D ya kidole cha tatu tena. Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Jina lilelile la herufi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ndiyo, zimetengana kwa oktava
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hapana, ni noti tofauti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.translation: Vidole vipi hugusana kwenye uzi wa A?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 2 na 3
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1 na 2
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 3 na 4
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: B hadi C diesi ni toni nzima, hivyo 1 na 2 zina nafasi. C diesi hadi D ni nusu toni, hivyo 2 na 3 hugusana.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli ya noti nne
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Uzi wa E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · title

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa E, kidole cha kwanza hupiga F diesi, cha pili juu G diesi, na cha tatu A. Ni umbo la uzi wa A kwenye uzi mmoja juu. Shusha mkono wa upinde hadi kimo cha E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, F diesi, G diesi, A. Umbo lilelile la uzi wa A.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu kwenye E hupiga A. Unaweza kukagua sauti yake kwa kuilinganisha na nini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Uzi wa A wazi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi wa G wazi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hakuna; amini mkono wako
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: Uzi wa A wazi uko oktava moja chini, hivyo hulia pamoja na A yako inapokuwa sahihi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli ya A meja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Unganisha nusu: A, B, C diesi, D kwenye uzi wa A, kisha E, F diesi, G diesi, A kwenye uzi wa E. Noti nane, A hadi A, umbo moja likipigwa mara mbili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya A meja polepole. Hamia E kwa noti nne za juu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Skeli ya A meja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodi unayoijua
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya Kifaransa ya karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700 hutumia noti ulizojifunza tu: A, B, C diesi, D kwenye uzi wa A, na E na F diesi kwenye uzi wa E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mstari wa mwanzo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.translation: Huu ni mstari upi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mstari wa katikati
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mstari wa mwanzo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga F diesi kwenye uzi wa E?

rows.translation: Jaribio la A na E

rows.translation: Vidole 1, 2, 3
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Toni nzima, toni nzima, nusu toni: huo ndio mpangilio kwenye A na E. Fikia sauti sahihi ya kila noti na uache nyuzi wazi ziimbe pamoja nawe.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili hadi cha tatu: ni hatua ya aina gani?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, C diesi, D, kisha D wazi. Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu hupiga noti ipi kwenye uzi wa E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: F diesi, G diesi, A kwenye uzi wa E, kisha A wazi oktava moja chini.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Skeli kushuka na kupanda
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Twinkle, kasi zaidi kidogo

rows.translation: Nyuzi za D na G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · title

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: Mpangilio uleule wa vidole kwenye nyuzi mbili za chini, D meja na melodi tatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · unit summary

rows.translation: Uzi wa D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · title

rows.translation: Umbo lilelile, uzi wa chini zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa D, kidole cha kwanza hupiga E, cha pili juu F diesi, na cha tatu G. Ni mpangilio wa uzi wa A kwenye uzi mmoja chini. Inua mkono wa upinde hatua moja.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, F diesi, G. Vidole vya pili na tatu hugusana.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: G hulia pamoja na G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha tatu kwenye uzi wa D iko oktava moja juu ya uzi wa G wazi. Sauti ikiwa sahihi, uzi wa G huvuma pamoja nayo.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha tatu, G wazi, G ya kidole cha tatu. Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa D, vidole vipi hugusana?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Ni mpangilio wa uzi wa A tena: toni nzima, toni nzima, nusu toni. Nusu toni iko kati ya 2 na 3.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli ya uzi wa D

rows.translation: Skeli ya D meja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · title

rows.translation: D hadi D
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Piga D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D, kisha A, B, C diesi, D kwenye uzi wa A. Skeli ya D meja ni umbo moja la vidole linalopigwa mara mbili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya D meja. Hamia uzi wa A kwenye noti ya tano.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kushuka

rows.translation: Noti zipi zina diesi katika D meja?

rows.translation: C na G

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D meja ina diesi mbili, F diesi na C diesi. Zote ni kidole 2 juu.

rows.translation: Lightly Row ni wimbo wa zamani wa watoto wa Kijerumani. Unapanda na kushuka skeli ya D meja kwenye nyuzi za D na A.

rows.translation: Uzi wa sauti ya chini zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa G, kidole cha kwanza hupiga A, cha pili juu B, na cha tatu C. Umbo lilelile tena. Inua mkono wa upinde hadi kimo chake cha juu zaidi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Sogeza kiwiko cha kushoto kidogo chini ya violini ili ufikie.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A ya kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa G, kisha uzi wa A wazi. Herufi ileile, oktava moja kati yake.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Nusu ya skeli ndefu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C kwenye uzi wa G pamoja na D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D huunda G meja. Ni oktava ya kwanza ya skeli ya oktava mbili utakayomalizia katika kitengo kinachofuata.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya G meja. Umbo lilelile kwenye nyuzi zote mbili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: G meja, oktava ya kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodi ya Beethoven
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Beethoven alitunga melodi hii kwa Simfoni yake ya Tisa mwaka 1824. Husogea zaidi kwa hatua za noti jirani, kwa hiyo vidole vyako hupita kimoja baada ya kingine.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Kila mstari huisha ndefu, fupi, ndefu: noti robo yenye nukta, ya nane na noti nusu. Nukta baada ya noti huongeza nusu ya muda wake.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Melodi yako ya kwanza ya fiddle
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya zamani ya violini ya Marekani hutumia mdundo uliopiga kwenye nyuzi wazi: ndefu, fupi-fupi, ndefu, ndefu. Wapiga fiddle huipiga katika mikusanyiko ya muziki kila mahali.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Melodi hii haitumii uzi upi kamwe?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
rows.translation: Iko kwenye nyuzi za D, A na E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Sehemu A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Jaribio la D na G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · title

rows.translation: Nyuzi nne, umbo moja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Toni nzima, toni nzima, nusu toni hufaa kwa kila uzi mpaka sasa. Inua mkono wa upinde kwa nyuzi za chini, uache oktava zilingane kwa sauti.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
rows.translation: Majaribio mawili ya oktava: G na G wazi, kisha A na A wazi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
rows.translation: Katika D meja, kidole kipi hupiga C diesi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu kwenye uzi wa A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cha tatu kwenye uzi wa A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa A
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Lightly Row, sehemu ya pili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Cabbage, kwa kasi kamili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini na kidole 2 juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · title

rows.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Sogeza kidole cha pili kubadili funguo: G meja katika oktava mbili, A minori na melodi za fiddle.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha pili huteleza nyuma
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
rows.translation: Telezesha kidole cha pili nyuma hadi kiguse cha kwanza. Kwenye uzi wa A hiyo ni C asilia, nusu toni chini ya C diesi. Wapigaji huita hapa kidole 2 chini.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Kidole cha pili hugusa cha kwanza; acha nafasi kabla ya cha tatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: B, kisha kidole 2 juu au kidole 2 chini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu, C diesi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini, C asilia
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Na hii je?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu, 2 chini, 2 juu, 2 chini. Sogeza kidole cha pili tu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini, kisha 2 juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: G meja, oktava mbili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · title

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini kwenye nyuzi za juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G meja inahitaji C asilia kwenye uzi wa A na G asilia kwenye uzi wa E, kwa hiyo kidole cha pili hukaa chini hapo. Kwenye nyuzi za G na D hubaki juu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: Uzi wa A katika G meja: kidole cha pili chini, kikigusa cha kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Sasa E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa E. Kidole 2 chini tena.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili hukaa wapi kwenye uzi wa E katika G meja?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Chini, kikigusa cha kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Juu, kikigusa cha tatu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hakitumiki
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
rows.translation: G asilia iko nusu toni juu ya F diesi, kwa hiyo kidole cha pili hukaa karibu kabisa na cha kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Nyuzi zote nne
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
rows.translation: Anza kwenye G wazi upande hadi G kwenye uzi wa E: noti kumi na tano, oktava mbili. Kidole 2 juu kwenye nyuzi za chini, kidole 2 chini kwenye nyuzi za juu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Skeli yenye hisia nzito zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
rows.translation: A minori huanza na A ya kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa G. Kidole cha pili kiko juu kwenye uzi wa G kwa B, kisha chini kwenye uzi wa D kwa F asilia.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
rows.translation: A minori, kupanda. Kidole 2 juu kwenye uzi wa G, kidole 2 chini kwenye uzi wa D.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Nini huifanya skeli hii iwe minori?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Its third note is a half step lower
rows.translation: Noti yake ya tatu iko nusu toni chini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It starts on a lower string
rows.translation: Inaanza kwenye uzi wa sauti ya chini zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Inapigwa polepole zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
rows.translation: A hadi C husikika nzito kihisia; A hadi C diesi husikika angavu. Nusu toni moja hubadili hisia nzima.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli ya A minori
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Minuet katika G
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · title

rows.translation: Ngoma ya mapigo matatu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
rows.translation: Minuet hii inatoka kwenye daftari ambalo Bach alimpa mkewe Anna Magdalena mwaka 1725. Sasa inahusishwa na Christian Petzold kama mtunzi. Hesabu mapigo matatu kwa kipimo.
