rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which C does the minuet use?
rows.translation: Minuet inatumia C ipi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C asilia, kidole 2 chini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C diesi, kidole 2 juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Minuet iko katika G meja, hivyo C ni asilia na kidole cha pili hukaa chini kwenye uzi wa A.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: F diesi ni kidole 2 juu kwenye uzi wa D: chini kwenye A, juu kwenye D.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Nusu ya pili inaanza juu: kidole cha nne hufikia B kwenye uzi wa E. Kisha cha tatu, halafu kidole 2 chini.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sehemu B
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu na 2 chini pamoja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark ni melodi ya fiddle ya Appalachia. Iko katika A lakini hutumia G asilia: kidole 2 juu kwa C diesi kwenye uzi wa A, kidole 2 chini kwa G kwenye uzi wa E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, F diesi, G, F diesi. Weka kidole cha pili chini, kikigusa cha kwanza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Melodi hii inatumia G ipi kwenye uzi wa E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G asilia, kidole 2 chini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G diesi, kidole 2 juu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: G asilia badala ya G diesi huipa Old Joe Clark sauti yake ya mtindo wa zamani.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodi ya karne iliyoanza 1700
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy ilichapishwa Scotland katika karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700, na bado hupigwa katika ngoma kote Marekani. Sehemu yake ya kwanza huzunguka A, F diesi na D, noti za kodi ya D meja.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: A wazi, F diesi ya kidole 2 juu kwenye D, D wazi, F diesi. Yumbisha kiwiko kati ya nyuzi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga G kwenye uzi wa E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy iko katika D meja, hivyo G ni asilia: kidole 2 juu kwa F diesi kwenye D, kidole 2 chini kwa G kwenye E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la kidole cha pili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · title

rows.translation: Chini au juu?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Kila ufunguo huamua nafasi ya kidole cha pili. Kabla ya kupiga, jiulize: kidole 2 juu au kidole 2 chini, na kwenye uzi upi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: F diesi, kisha kidole 2 juu au 2 chini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini, G asilia
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kidole 2 juu, G diesi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Kidole 2 chini na 2 juu kwenye uzi wa A, kisha kidole 2 chini na 2 juu kwenye uzi wa E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Katika A meja, kidole cha pili hukaa wapi kwenye nyuzi za A na E?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Juu kwenye zote mbili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Chini kwenye zote mbili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Chini kwenye A, juu kwenye E
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Minuet, vipimo 1 hadi 4
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Old Joe Clark, sehemu ya kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kueleza hisia
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · title

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Sauti kubwa na ndogo, slur, kidole cha nne, hatua ya kwanza ya vibrato, na Ode to Joy nzima.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · unit summary

rows.translation: Sauti kubwa na ndogo
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · title

rows.translation: Njia tatu za kuongeza ukubwa wa sauti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Ongeza uzito wa mkono, tumia kasi zaidi ya upinde, na sogeza mahali pa mguso karibu na daraja la nyuzi. Tumia zote tatu pamoja. Kwa sauti ndogo, fanya kinyume chake.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Forte na piano
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: Noti huonyesha sauti kubwa kwa f, ya forte, na ndogo kwa p, ya piano. Kuongeza ukubwa wa sauti taratibu ni crescendo; kuupunguza taratibu ni diminuendo.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
rows.translation: Kupiga forte, upinde unasogea wapi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Karibu zaidi na daraja la nyuzi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Juu ya ubao wa vidole
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hakuna; bana tu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Karibu na daraja, uzi hukubali uzito na kasi zaidi, hivyo hutoa sauti kubwa zaidi bila kukwaruza.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Kila noti mara mbili: forte, kisha piano. Dumisha kimo sahihi huku ukubwa wa sauti ukibadilika.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Noti ndefu: ongeza, kisha punguza sauti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lightly Row, sauti ndogo kisha kubwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Viungo vya slur
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · title

rows.translation: Noti mbili, mwendo mmoja wa upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
rows.translation: Mstari uliopinda juu ya noti ni slur: zipige zote kwa mwendo mmoja wa upinde. Mkono wa kushoto hubadili noti huku upinde ukiendelea kusogea.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
rows.translation: Unganisha A hadi B kwa pigo moja chini, kisha B hadi A kwa pigo moja juu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Gawanya upinde kwa noti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
rows.translation: Noti mbili kwa mwendo mmoja wa upinde maana yake kila moja hupata nusu yake. Panga mapema, uanze slur ukiwa na upinde wa kutosha kwa noti zote mbili.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a slur tell you?
rows.translation: Slur hukuambia nini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Play the notes in one bow
rows.translation: Piga noti kwa mwendo mmoja wa upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Piga noti kwa sauti kubwa zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Simamisha upinde kati ya noti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Skeli kwa jozi zilizounganishwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti za nane zilizounganishwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kidole chako cha nne
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · title

rows.translation: Toni nzima juu ya cha tatu
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Kidole cha nne hufikia toni nzima juu ya cha tatu. Kwenye uzi wa D hiyo ni A, noti ileile ya uzi wa A wazi. Kidole kibaki kimepinda, mkono ukielemea upande wake.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A ya kidole cha nne kwenye uzi wa D, A wazi, kisha cha nne tena. Linganisha sauti kikamilifu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Kwa nini utumie kidole cha nne badala ya uzi wazi?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Huepusha kuvuka uzi na hutoa sauti laini zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Daima hutoa sauti kubwa zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
rows.translation: Nyuzi wazi hazina sauti sahihi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: Noti ya kidole huweka mstari kwenye uzi mmoja na kuchanganyika na noti zinazouzunguka. Nyuzi wazi hulia kwa sauti angavu zaidi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D ya kidole cha tatu, E ya cha nne kwenye uzi wa A, kisha E wazi. Sikiliza kama zinalingana.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: D hadi A kwenye uzi mmoja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lightly Row kwenye uzi mmoja
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Melodi ya tenzi ya polepole
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu huimbwa kwa melodi ya zamani ya Marekani iitwayo New Britain. Jozi zake za noti za haraka huunganishwa kwa slur. Acha noti ndefu ziimbe kwa upinde mzima wa polepole.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: G hadi B na kurudi huvuka nyuzi. Yumba kwa ulaini kuanzia kiwikoni.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Unapigaje jozi ya haraka kwa upinde, kama B hadi G?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti zote mbili kwa mwendo mmoja wa upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mwendo mmoja wa upinde kwa kila noti
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: Zimeunganishwa kwa slur, hivyo zinatumia mwendo mmoja wa upinde.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kishazi cha pili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kujiandaa kwa vibrato
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · title

rows.translation: Vibrato ni nini
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato ni wimbi dogo thabiti la kimo cha sauti linaloipa noti ndefu uhai. Ncha ya kidole huviringika kidogo kurudi nyuma kutoka noti na kurudi tena, mara kwa mara, ikisogezwa na mkono.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Sauti sahihi kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato haiwezi kuokoa noti isiyo sahihi; huipa rangi noti iliyo kwenye kimo sahihi tu. Wapigaji wengi huiongeza vidole vikianza kutua kwa usahihi bila kutafuta.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: Noti huwa tayari kwa vibrato lini?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ikiwa tayari ina sauti sahihi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ikiwa juu kidogo kuliko inavyotakiwa
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Upinde ukienda haraka
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mwendo wa kwanza, bila upinde
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Weka kidole cha pili kwenye uzi wa A. Acha ncha yake palepale, legeza kifundo cha kidole, kisha yumbisha mkono polepole kuelekea kichwani na kurudi. Mwendo mdogo na ulio sawa. Mwalimu anaweza kusaidia kukuangalia.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Sasa piga hizi kwa upinde bila vibrato, kila moja ikiwa na kimo sahihi. Hapo ndipo vibrato huanzia.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sauti ndefu, zenye kimo sahihi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Slur za fiddle
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler ilikuwa imechapishwa kufikia 1847. Wapiga fiddle huunganisha noti zake za haraka zaidi kwa jozi, jambo linaloipa melodi mruko wake. Anza polepole, jozi zikiwa sawa.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Sehemu ya kwanza, mwisho
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.translation: Kwa nini wapiga fiddle huunganisha jozi za haraka?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.translation: Huokoa upinde na huongeza mwendo wa kuyumba
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hufanya kila noti iwe na sauti kubwa zaidi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.translation: Huweka nyuzi katika sauti sahihi
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, F diesi, A kwenye uzi wa E: kidole cha tatu, kidole 2 chini, cha kwanza, cha tatu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Onyesho: Ode to Joy
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title

rows.translation: Onyesho lako
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Unganisha yote: vidole vyenye sauti sahihi, upinde ulionyooka, slur na ukubwa mbalimbali wa sauti. Anza piano, ongeza sauti katikati, umalizie forte.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Mazoezi ya mwanzo: linganisha kidole cha nne na nyuzi wazi, A kisha E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Alama ipi humaanisha kuongeza ukubwa wa sauti taratibu?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ode to Joy, nusu ya kwanza
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Ode to Joy, nusu ya pili
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Keti, piga kwa upinde kwa usahihi, kutoka nyuzi wazi hadi The Swan
rows.context: Cello course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hujambo, cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Keti, weka mguu wa cello, shika upinde, piga nyuzi wazi na wimbo wako wa kwanza.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary

rows.translation: Fahamu cello yako
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu, nyuzi ni C, G, D na A. C ni mnene zaidi na ya sauti ya chini zaidi. A ni mwembamba zaidi na ya sauti ya juu zaidi; tunauita uzi 1.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Uzi upi una sauti ya chini zaidi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C ni uzi mnene zaidi na wenye sauti ya chini zaidi. Nyuzi huhesabiwa kutoka A (1) hadi C (4).
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga uzi 1, yaani A, kwa kidole na uache usikike.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sasa uzi 2, yaani D.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi mnene zaidi, yaani C. Acha uvume.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Keti na cello yako
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title

rows.translation: Keti wima karibu na ukingo
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Keti karibu na ukingo wa mbele wa kiti, nyayo sakafuni na magoti yakitengana, kana kwamba unaweza kusimama kwa urahisi. Cello hukaa kati ya magoti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Weka mguu wa cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Vuta mguu wa cello nje hadi ukingo wake wa juu uguse kifua kwenye mfupa wa kidari, na kigingi cha C kiwe karibu na sikio la kushoto. Kaza skrubu. Kizuizi au kamba huzuia mguu kuteleza.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Ukingo wa juu wa cello hugusa sehemu ipi ya mwili wako?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kifuani, kwenye mfupa wa kidari
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Bega lako la kushoto
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Chini ya kidevu chako
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Cello huegemea nyuma kifuani, na magoti huishikilia kwa upole kutoka pembeni.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Ukiwa umeketi wima, piga D kwa kidole, kisha G. Mabega yabaki yamelegea.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mkono uliopinda, wenye uzito
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Pinda gumba, uweke ncha yake panapokutana frog na fimbo, mkabala na kidole cha kati. Tandaza vidole vyote vinne juu ya fimbo na uache uzito wa mkono ushuke.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Weka upinde kwenye uzi wa D, katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Uvute polepole kwenda kulia.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Sasa uzi wa A. Sogeza mkono mzima hadi kimo chake, kisha uvute polepole.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu: C, G, D, A. Kila uzi uko majina matano ya herufi juu ya uliotangulia; umbali huo huitwa wa tano. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Mkono wa kulia huamua upinde utapiga uzi upi. Kila uzi una kimo chake cha mkono, kama ngazi za kupandia. Sogeza mkono mzima, si sehemu ya kiganja tu.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Piga uzi wa C kwa upinde, kisha G. Acha mkono utulie kwenye kila kimo.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sasa D, kisha A.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Rekebisha sauti ya cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Okestra hurekebisha sauti kwa A. Timbre huonyesha kwa senti jinsi kila uzi ulivyo mbali na noti yake; senti 100 ni nusu toni, hatua ndogo zaidi kwenye piano. Rekebisha A, kisha D, G na C.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Sasa D, G na C. Rekebisha kila uzi, kisha upige kwa upinde na ushikilie sauti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Keti wima, mguu wa cello ukiwa umewekwa, shika upinde kwa upole katikati ya daraja la nyuzi na ubao wa vidole. Sasa piga yote uliyojifunza katika kitengo hiki.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb uko kwenye uzi wa D: D wazi, kidole cha kwanza toni nzima juu kwa E, cha tatu toni nzima mbili juu kwa F diesi. Piga kwanza kwa kidole, kisha kwa upinde.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye uzi wa D, toni nzima juu. Hiyo ni E.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu, toni nzima juu ya cha kwanza. Hiyo ni F diesi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: F diesi, E, D, E, kisha F diesi mara tatu.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Pigo moja la chini polepole, kisha la juu polepole kwenye D. Sauti ibaki sawa hadi mwisho.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Upinde mzima kwenye D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Noti robo kwenye D na A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Acha mkono ubadilishane kati ya vimo viwili.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mkono wako, ukibadili kimo
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kugeuza cello
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Kutoka C kwenda D huruka uzi wa G, hivyo mkono hufanya mwendo mkubwa zaidi. Sogea kwa ulaini na usiache uzi wa katikati usikike.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nafasi ya kwanza: D na A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni: piga D meja na melodi zako za kwanza.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza: E
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title

rows.translation: Kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Nusu toni ni hatua ndogo zaidi katika muziki. Katika nafasi ya kwanza, vidole hutengana kwa nusu toni, vikianzia toni nzima (nusu toni mbili) juu ya uzi wazi. Gumba nyuma ya shingo, mkabala na kidole cha pili.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: D wazi, kisha E kwa kidole cha kwanza. Shikilia E hadi itulie kwenye sauti sahihi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Kidole kilekile kwenye uzi wa A: A wazi, kisha B.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: D wazi, kisha E. Zimetengana kwa kiasi gani?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Kidole cha kwanza kwenye D na A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu: F diesi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title

rows.translation: Ruka kidole
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hupiga F diesi, toni nzima juu ya E. Kidole cha pili kikae juu ya nafasi yake kati ya 1 na 3 bila kubonyeza, ili mkono udumishe umbo lake.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, F diesi. Acha kidole cha kwanza chini cha tatu kinapopiga.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kutoka E hadi noti inayofuata: ni hatua ya aina gani?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Kwa nini kidole cha pili hukaa juu ya nafasi yake?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Hudumisha nafasi kati ya vidole
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hupiga F diesi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Huishikilia cello juu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Kila kidole kina nusu toni yake. Kuviacha vyote vinne mahali pake hufanya kila noti itue sehemu ileile kila mara.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Vidole vilevile kwenye uzi wa A: A wazi, B, C diesi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kidole cha nne: G
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · title

rows.translation: Vidole vyote vinne
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Kidole cha nne hupiga G, nusu toni juu ya F diesi. D, E, F diesi, G ni nusu ya kwanza ya skeli ya D meja: wazi, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, F diesi, G: wazi, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha nne kwenye uzi wa D iko oktava moja juu ya uzi wa G wazi: herufi ileile, noti nane juu. Sauti ikiwa sahihi, uzi wa G huvuma pamoja nayo.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha nne, G wazi, kisha G ya kidole cha nne tena. Sikiliza mwangwi wa uzi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Piga D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D, kisha A, B, C diesi, D kwenye uzi wa A. Vidole vilevile mara mbili: wazi, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Vidole vipi hupiga D meja kwenye kila uzi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 3, 4
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 2, 3
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Wazi, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Melodi hii ya Kifaransa ya karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700 hutumia noti ulizojifunza tu: D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D, na A na B kwenye uzi wa A.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga B kwenye uzi wa A?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cha tatu, kwenye uzi wa D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cha pili, kwenye uzi wa D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cha kwanza, kwenye uzi wa A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la D na A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · title

rows.translation: Dumisha umbo la mkono
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 3, 4 kwenye nyuzi za D na A. Dumisha umbo la mkono, fikia sauti sahihi ya kila noti, na uache oktava zilingane kwa sauti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Kidole cha tatu hadi cha nne: ni hatua ya aina gani?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Majaribio mawili ya oktava: G na G wazi, kisha D ya kidole cha nne na D wazi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga C diesi kwenye uzi wa A?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Nyuzi za G na C
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Nyuzi mbili za chini, skeli za C meja na G meja, na melodi tatu maarufu za kale.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary

rows.translation: Vidole vilevile, uzi wa chini zaidi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa G, kidole cha kwanza hupiga A, cha tatu B, na cha nne C. Nafasi kati ya vidole ni zilezile za D. Acha mkono utulie kwenye kimo cha uzi wa G.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: G, A, B, C: wazi, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C kwenye uzi wa G pamoja na D, E, F diesi, G kwenye uzi wa D huunda skeli ya G meja. Vidole vilevile kwenye nyuzi zote mbili.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Kidole kipi hupiga C kwenye uzi wa G?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Skeli ya G meja
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Uzi wa C
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · title

rows.translation: Uzi wa sauti nzito zaidi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Kwenye uzi wa C, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D, cha tatu E, na cha nne F. Uzi mnene huhitaji upinde wa polepole wenye uzito ili utoe sauti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: wazi, 1, 3, 4. Ipe kila noti muda wa kusikika.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: C meja, oktava ya chini
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F kwenye uzi wa C pamoja na G, A, B, C kwenye uzi wa G ni skeli ya C meja. Haina diesi hata moja.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Panda skeli ya C meja. Ukifika juu, sikiliza C ikiimba pamoja na uzi wa C wazi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Skeli ya C meja
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha pili: F asilia
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · title

rows.translation: Kidole cha pili kinajiunga
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Kidole cha pili hupiga F asilia kwenye uzi wa D, nusu toni chini ya F diesi, na C asilia kwenye uzi wa A. C meja inahitaji zote mbili.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: wazi, 1, 2, 4. Kidole cha pili hukaa karibu kabisa na cha kwanza.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, kisha kidole cha pili au cha tatu?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Cha pili: F asilia
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Cha tatu: F diesi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kidole kimoja, nusu toni moja
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Wapiga cello hukipa kila kidole nusu toni yake, hivyo F hutumia cha pili, F diesi cha tatu. Noti iliyo nje kidogo ya mkono, kama F diesi kwenye uzi wa C, huhitaji kunyoosha nafasi kati ya vidole. Kozi hii huchagua funguo zisizohitaji hivyo.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C meja, oktava ya pili: kidole cha pili kwa F na C ya juu.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: C meja, oktava mbili
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.translation: Ode to Joy, oktava moja juu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Wimbo wa kubembeleza wa mwaka 1868
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms alitunga wimbo huu wa kubembeleza mwaka 1868. Unayumba kwa mapigo matatu kwenye nyuzi za G na D. Tumia mipigo mirefu ya polepole ya upinde na uache kila kishazi kipumue.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, F diesi, E: vidole 4, 3, 1. Hapa ndipo wimbo wa kubembeleza unapofika juu zaidi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Wimbo wa jadi wa Kifaransa
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune ni wimbo wa jadi wa Kifaransa wa karne iliyoanza mwaka 1700. Uko kwenye nyuzi za G na D, C ikiwa chini ya kidole cha nne.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: D wazi, kisha vidole 4, 3, 1 na G wazi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Noti zipi katika melodi hii ni nyuzi wazi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C na A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Wa jadi (Ufaransa, karne ya 18)
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.translation: Jaribio la nyuzi za chini
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · title

rows.translation: Nyuzi nne, mkono mmoja
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Wazi, 1, 3, 4 kwenye kila uzi, pamoja na kidole cha pili kwa F na C asilia. Upinde wa polepole wenye uzito kwenye nyuzi za chini.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: D, E, kisha kidole kipi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Majaribio mawili ya oktava: C na C wazi, kisha G na G wazi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Ufunguo upi kati ya hii hauna diesi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D meja
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Au clair, sehemu ya pili
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.translation: Misingi ya kuhama nafasi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · title

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Teleza hadi nafasi ya nne, kagua kwa sikio, na upige The Swan na Neema ya Ajabu.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kuhama kwako kwa kwanza
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · title

rows.translation: Kuhama nafasi ni nini
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Kuhama nafasi husogeza mkono mzima kwenda sehemu mpya kwenye uzi. Punguza mgandamizo wa kidole, kitelezeshe kwenye uzi bila kukiinua, na uache gumba lisafiri pamoja na mkono.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nafasi ya nne
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D kwenye uzi wa A, noti iliyopigwa na cha nne katika nafasi ya kwanza. Gumba hutulia pale shingo inapopinda kuingia mwilini mwa ala.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B kwa kidole cha kwanza, kisha telezesha kidole hicho juu hadi D. Kisibane unapohama.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Nini husogea unapohama nafasi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mkono mzima, pamoja na gumba
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kidole tu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Gumba tu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Kusogeza mkono kama kitu kimoja hudumisha nafasi kati ya vidole, hivyo noti zinazofuata pia hutua kwa sauti sahihi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Hama juu, urudi, kisha juu tena kwa kidole cha kwanza. Fikia sauti sahihi ya kila noti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kuhama kwa kidole cha kwanza
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Nafasi ya nne kwenye A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · title

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa A, kidole cha kwanza hupiga D, cha tatu E, na cha nne F. Umbo lilelile la nafasi ya kwanza: kidole kimoja kwa kila nusu toni.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: vidole 1, 3, 4. Huku juu noti ziko karibu zaidi kidogo.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: A wazi, B, hama kwa kidole cha kwanza hadi D, kisha E kwa cha tatu.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa A, kidole kipi hupiga E?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.translation: Kupanda nafasi ya nne na kurudi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Nafasi ya nne kwenye D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · title

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.translation: Kagua kwa kulinganisha na A wazi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa D, kidole cha kwanza hupiga G na cha tatu A, noti ileile ya uzi wa A wazi. Zipige moja baada ya nyingine na uzilinganishe.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G ya kidole cha kwanza, kisha A ya cha tatu, zote kwenye uzi wa D.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A ya nafasi ya nne, A wazi, A ya nafasi ya nne. Zifanye ziwe sauti moja.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Jozi ipi inalingana?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Jozi ya kwanza
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Jozi ya pili
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Hama nafasi kwenye uzi wa D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Piga E kwa kidole cha kwanza katika nafasi ya kwanza, kisha telezesha kidole hicho juu hadi G. Hizo ni nusu toni tatu, umbali uleule wa B hadi D kwenye uzi wa A.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E ya kidole cha kwanza, kisha teleza hadi G kwa kidole hichohicho. Acha gumba nalo lisogee.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kuhama nafasi kwenye uzi wa D
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: The Swan inatoka The Carnival of the Animals, iliyotungwa na Camille Saint-Saëns mwaka 1886. Hiki ni kishazi chake cha mwanzo, kilichorahisishwa na kushushwa oktava moja.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Upinde unaoimba
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Noti ndefu huhitaji upinde wa polepole. Weka upinde karibu na daraja la nyuzi na ugawanye mwendo kwa usawa, ili kila noti idumu hadi mwisho wake bila kupungua sauti.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, F diesi, B: kidole cha nne na cha tatu kwenye D, kisha cha tatu kwenye G.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.translation: Unazuiaje sauti ya noti ndefu isipungue?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Gawanya mwendo wa upinde kwa usawa
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Bonyeza zaidi mwishoni
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tumia upinde wa haraka
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Melodi kuu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Koda
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

rows.translation: Hama uzi wazi unapolia
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: Katika Neema ya Ajabu, D ya juu huja mara tu baada ya A wazi. A inapolia, telezesha mkono juu hadi nafasi ya nne na utue kwenye D kwa kidole cha kwanza.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, A wazi, kisha D ya kidole cha kwanza katika nafasi ya nne. Hama A inapolia.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.translation: Ni wakati gani rahisi zaidi wa kuhama nafasi?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Uzi wazi unapolia
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
rows.translation: Katikati ya noti ndefu
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kamwe; nyoosha vidole badala yake
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Uzi wazi unapolia, mkono wa kushoto uko huru, kwa hiyo kuhama hakusikiki.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Jaribio la kuhama nafasi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · title

rows.translation: Bila kubana, pamoja, kwa usahihi
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Punguza mgandamizo wa kidole, sogeza mkono na gumba pamoja, kisha kagua unapotua. Nyuzi wazi zitakuambia kama sauti ni sahihi.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A ya nafasi ya nne kwenye uzi wa D, kisha A wazi. Zilinganishe.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Katika nafasi ya nne, kidole cha kwanza hupiga noti ipi kwenye uzi wa A?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Neema ya Ajabu, kishazi cha kwanza
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Kutoka jozi za nyuzi hadi melodi za fiddle na chop ya bluegrass
rows.context: Mandolin course · course subtitle

rows.translation: Hujambo, mandolin
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · title

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Fahamu jozi za nyuzi, rekebisha sauti zake na upige noti zote nne wazi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · unit summary

rows.translation: Fahamu mandolin yako
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · title

rows.translation: Nyuzi nane, noti nne
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: Mandolin ina nyuzi nane katika jozi nne, zinazoitwa courses. Nyuzi mbili za jozi hurekebishwa kuwa noti ileile na hupigwa pamoja, hivyo unachukulia kila jozi kama uzi mmoja.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kuhesabu jozi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Jozi iliyo karibu zaidi na uso wako ina sauti ya chini zaidi, jozi 4. Iliyo karibu zaidi na sakafu ina sauti ya juu zaidi, jozi 1. Somo likisema uzi 3, linamaanisha jozi ya tatu.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.translation: Unaipigaje jozi?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Nyuzi zote mbili pamoja, kama noti moja
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi mnene zaidi tu
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Uzi mmoja, kisha mwingine
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Nyuzi mbili ziko karibu, hivyo mpigo mmoja wa kijiti huzigusa zote. Pamoja hulia kama noti moja yenye sauti iliyojaa zaidi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Piga jozi ya chini zaidi, jozi 4, na uache isikike.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sasa jozi ya juu zaidi, jozi 1.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Rekebisha sauti za jozi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · title

rows.translation: Nyuzi mbili, kimo kimoja cha sauti
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Kila jozi lazima ilingane na kipima sauti na nyuzi zake zilingane zenyewe. Nyuzi zake mbili zisipolingana, utasikia sauti ikiyumba polepole. Rekebisha uzi mmoja, kisha ulete mwenzake kwenye noti ileile.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Jozi 3, jozi ya D. Rekebisha nyuzi zote mbili hadi kuyumba kukome.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Sasa jozi 2, jozi ya A.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Jozi moja ina sauti inayoyumba polepole. Tatizo ni nini?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Nyuzi zake mbili hazilingani
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kijiti cha kupigia ni kinene mno
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Unabonyeza kwa nguvu mno
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Kuyumba huko huitwa beating, mapigo ya mwingiliano: sauti za nyuzi mbili zimetengana kidogo. Zirekebishe hadi sauti itulie.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Rekebisha ukipanda hadi noti
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Legeza hadi chini kidogo ya noti, kisha kaza kupanda hadi uifikie. Kukaribia kutoka chini huzuia uzi kuteleza na kushuka sauti baadaye.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Jozi 4, kisha jozi 1. Pandisha kila uzi hadi noti yake kutoka chini.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Shika kijiti cha kupigia
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · title

rows.translation: Bana kwa upole
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Shika kijiti kati ya sehemu laini ya gumba na ubavu wa kidole cha shahada kilichopinda. Ncha pekee ionekane. Kifundo kibaki kimelegea, kama unapokung'uta maji mkononi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Kiasi gani cha kijiti kinapaswa kuonekana?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Nusu yake
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ncha tu
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kiasi kikubwa iwezekanavyo
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Ncha fupi hukupa udhibiti na sauti safi. Kijiti kikitokeza sana hukwama kwenye jozi za nyuzi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Chini kupitia jozi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Sukuma kijiti chini kupitia nyuzi zote mbili za jozi kwa mwendo mmoja mdogo, usimame baada tu ya kuzipita. Egemeza sehemu ya chini ya kiganja kwa upole karibu na daraja la nyuzi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nne chini, nne chini
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Mbili kwa kila jozi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu, jozi ni G, D, A na E. Kumbuka kwa Kiingereza: Good Dogs Always Eat. Violini hupangwa sauti vivyo hivyo, kwa hiyo melodi za fiddle hufaa kwa urahisi kwenye mandolin.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Kutoka sauti ya chini hadi juu: G, D, A, E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Jozi 2 inaitwaje?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Jozi ipi ina sauti ya chini zaidi?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Sasa kutoka sauti ya juu hadi chini: E, A, D, G.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kupanda na kushuka tena
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.translation: Changamoto ya nyuzi wazi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · title

rows.translation: Onyesha unachojua
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Jozi zenye sauti sahihi, kijiti kilichoshikwa bila kubana, na noti nne wazi. Piga kila moja kwa usafi, nyuzi zote mbili za jozi zikilia.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.translation: Jozi ipi ina kimo cha sauti cha juu zaidi?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Jozi 4, G
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Jozi 2, A
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Jozi 1, E
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Jozi huhesabiwa kutoka ya sauti ya juu zaidi, jozi 1, hadi ya chini zaidi, jozi 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Tafuta kila jozi kwa jina lake.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mfuatano wa nyuzi wazi
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb uko kwenye jozi ya D: D wazi, E kwenye freti 2 kwa kidole cha kwanza, na F diesi kwenye freti 4 kwa cha pili.
