rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Mpangilio, funguo nne na alama zake. Ukiwa huna uhakika, unda skeli kuanzia noti msingi: toni nzima, nzima, nusu, nzima, nzima, nzima, nusu.

rows.translation: Taja umbali kati ya noti mbili kwa namba na aina yake, na uupime kwa nusu toni.

rows.translation: Hesabu herufi

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Namba ya umbali wa noti hutokana na kuhesabu majina ya herufi, ukijumuisha mwanzo na mwisho. C kupanda hadi E huhesabu C, D, E: herufi tatu, hivyo ni umbali wa tatu.

rows.translation: Umbali wa pili
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: E, F, G, A: herufi nne.

rows.translation: Diesi hazibadili hesabu

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Diesi na bemoli hazibadili namba ya umbali wa noti. C hadi E♭ na C hadi E zote ni umbali wa tatu: C, D, E kwa vyovyote. Zinatofautiana kwa ukubwa, ambao unafuata.

rows.translation: F kupanda hadi D ni…

rows.translation: Umbali wa sita

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: herufi sita.

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: herufi nane, oktava.

rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu kwa ukubwa
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · title

rows.translation: Hesabu nusu toni kupata ukubwa
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Aina mbili za umbali zenye namba ileile zinaweza kuwa na ukubwa tofauti. Kupima kwa usahihi, hesabu nusu toni. C kupanda hadi E ni nne; C kupanda hadi E♭ ni tatu.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Kuna nusu toni ngapi kutoka D kupanda hadi F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: hatua tatu.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Umbali wa tatu wenye nusu toni nne ni wa meja, kama C hadi E. Wenye tatu ni wa minori, kama C hadi E♭ au A hadi C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: E kupanda hadi G♯ ni…

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: E hadi G♯ ina nusu toni nne.

rows.translation: Umbali kamili wa noti
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · title

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Unisoni, umbali wa nne, tano na oktava huitwa kamili. Umbali wa nne kamili una nusu toni tano, wa tano kamili saba, na oktava kumi na mbili.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.translation: Umbali wa tano kamili una nusu toni ngapi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi G: nusu toni saba.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi F ni…
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: C hadi F ina nusu toni tano.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.translation: Zingatia B na F
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Umbali mwingi wa tano wa vitufe vyeupe ni kamili, lakini B kupanda hadi F una nusu toni sita tu. Huitwa umbali wa tano wa diminished. Ukiwa na shaka, hesabu nusu toni.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Ni umbali upi wa tano hapa ulio mdogo kuliko kamili?

rows.translation: C hadi G

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.

rows.translation: Umbali wa meja na minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili, tatu, sita na saba una ukubwa wa meja na minori. Minori daima ni nusu toni moja ndogo kuliko meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ukubwa kwa nusu toni
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Umbali wa pili: minori 1, meja 2. Wa tatu: minori 3, meja 4. Wa sita: minori 8, meja 9. Wa saba: minori 10, meja 11.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.translation: C kupanda hadi A ni…

rows.translation: Nusu toni moja pungufu ya oktava.

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C huunda umbali wa sita. Una nusu toni nane, kwa hiyo ni wa minori.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Hesabu herufi kupata namba. Hesabu nusu toni kupata ukubwa. Pamoja hutaja umbali wowote wa noti.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: F kupanda hadi A ni…
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A ni umbali wa tatu, na nusu toni nne huufanya wa meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: D kupanda hadi A ni…
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D hadi A ina nusu toni saba.

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: B kupanda hadi D ni…

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.

rows.translation: Kodi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · title

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Panga umbali wa tatu kuunda kodi za noti tatu, unda kodi za meja na minori, na zipe kodi za ufunguo namba.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · unit summary

rows.translation: Kuunda kodi ya noti tatu
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · title

rows.translation: Kupanga umbali wa tatu
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu hupanga noti kwa umbali wa tatu. Anza na noti yoyote, ruka herufi moja, chukua inayofuata, ruka tena. C, ruka D, E, ruka F, G: C E G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda kodi ya noti tatu inayojengwa kwenye G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, ruka A, B, ruka C, D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti msingi, ya tatu, ya tano
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Noti ambayo kodi ya noti tatu hujengwa juu yake ni noti msingi. Ya katikati ni ya tatu na ya juu ni ya tano, majina yakitokana na umbali wake juu ya msingi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Katika kodi ya noti tatu F A C, noti msingi ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F ni noti ya chini ambayo kodi hiyo hujengwa juu yake.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Katika kodi ya noti tatu D F A, noti ya tano ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D kupanda hadi A ni umbali wa tano: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia vitufe vyeupe tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye E?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, ruka F, G, ruka A, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya C noti moja baada ya nyingine: C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu za meja na minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · title

rows.translation: Kodi za noti tatu za meja
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu ya meja ina umbali wa tatu wa meja chini, nusu toni nne, kisha wa minori juu. C E G ni meja. F A C na G B D pia.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Geuza mpangilio wa umbali wa tatu upate minori: wa minori chini, kisha wa meja juu. Shusha noti ya katikati ya C meja upate C minori: C E♭ G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda D minori?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D hadi F ni umbali wa tatu wa minori; F hadi A ni wa meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda E meja?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E hadi G♯ ni umbali wa tatu wa meja; G♯ hadi B ni wa minori.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: A C E ni meja au minori?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A hadi C ni umbali wa tatu wa minori, nusu toni tatu.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Piga au imba A minori noti moja baada ya nyingine: A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kodi za ufunguo
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · title

rows.translation: Kodi kutoka kwenye skeli
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Jenga kodi ya noti tatu kwenye kila noti ya skeli, ukitumia noti za skeli hiyo tu, upate familia ya kodi za ufunguo huo. C meja ina saba, moja kwa kila noti.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye D?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: umbali wa tatu wa minori, kisha wa meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: umbali wa tatu wa meja, kisha wa minori.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi ya diminished
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Kodi ya noti tatu kwenye B ni tofauti: B D F. Nafasi zote mbili za tatu ni za minori, hivyo ni kodi ya diminished. Husikika yenye mvutano na inataka kuendelea.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi zipi ni meja?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D, E na A
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: C, F na G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C na G B D kila moja ina umbali wa tatu wa meja chini.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Kwa kutumia noti za C meja tu, kodi ipi ya noti tatu hujengwa kwenye A?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: umbali wa tatu wa minori, kisha wa meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya noti tatu ya diminished kwenye B: B, D, F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Namba za Kirumi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · title

rows.translation: Kuzipa kodi namba
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Wanamuziki huzipa kodi za ufunguo namba za Kirumi: I kwa kodi kwenye noti 1, hadi vii kwa noti 7. Herufi kubwa humaanisha meja, ndogo minori, na ° diminished.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mpangilio wa ufunguo wa meja
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Kila ufunguo wa meja hufuata mpangilio mmoja: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. Katika C meja ni C, D minori, E minori, F, G, A minori na B diminished.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.translation: Noti ya nne ya C meja ni F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya vi ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Noti ya sita ni A, na vi yenye herufi ndogo humaanisha minori.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ya V ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Hesabu kutoka G: G, A, B, C, D. Noti ya tano ni D, na V ni meja.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Kwa nini ii imeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Ni kodi yenye sauti ndogo
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Inapigwa kwa sauti ya juu zaidi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Ni kodi ya minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: C minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: noti ya nne ni C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Changamoto ya kodi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · title

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.translation: Taja noti zake, isikie, ipe namba
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Panga umbali wa tatu, kagua ukubwa wake, kisha weka kodi katika ufunguo wake: meja kwenye I, IV na V, minori kwenye ii, iii na vi, diminished kwenye vii°.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda G meja?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti zipi huunda A minori?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, kodi ya ii ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, kodi ya V ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: noti ya tano ni C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi ipi ya noti tatu ni ya diminished?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: B hadi D na D hadi F zote ni umbali wa tatu wa minori.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Piga au imba kodi ya noti tatu ya G meja: G, B, D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · challenge thy-7-5 “Chords challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mifuatano ya kodi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · title

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Kodi zinavyosogea katika nyimbo: I–IV–V, mzunguko wa pop, ii–V–I, blues ya vipimo 12 na kadensi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · unit summary

rows.translation: I, IV na V
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · title

rows.translation: Kodi tatu
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Nyimbo nyingi sana za jadi, rock na country hutumia kodi tatu tu: I, IV na V. Katika C meja ni C, F na G. Pamoja zina kila noti ya skeli.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, I, IV na V ni zipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G, B na D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G, A na D
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Hesabu kutoka G: noti 1 ni G, noti 4 ni C, noti 5 ni D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.translation: Je, hii inaishia kwenye kodi ya msingi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Msingini, mbali, na kurudi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I huhisiwa kama msingi. IV huenda mbali. V hujenga mvutano unaovutia kurudi I. Safari hiyo, kutoka na kurudi tena, huunda nyimbo nyingi sana.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Kodi ipi huvutia zaidi kurudi I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V hujenga mvutano unaotulia kwenye I.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Katika D meja, kodi ya IV ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: noti ya nne ni G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za I, IV, V, I katika C: C, F, G, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mfuatano wa pop
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · title

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Mzunguko huu wa kodi nne hutumika katika nyimbo nyingi sana za pop. Katika C meja ni C, G, A minori, F. vi ya minori huongeza hisia nzito kidogo kabla IV haijaelekea kurudi msingi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Unasikia mfuatano upi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Katika G meja, I–V–vi–IV ni zipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G, D, E minori, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: G, D, C, E minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: Katika G: I ni G, V ni D, vi ni E minori, IV ni C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Kodi zilezile, mwanzo mpya
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Anza mzunguko uleule kwenye vi upate vi–IV–I–V: A minori, F, C, G. Kodi ni zilezile, lakini kuanza kwa minori huleta hisia nzito zaidi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, kodi ya vi ni ipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: noti ya sita ni D, na vi ni minori.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za I–V–vi–IV katika C: C, G, A, F.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Mfuatano unaotumika sana katika jazz
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I ndio mfuatano unaotumika zaidi katika jazz. Katika C meja: D minori, G, C. Kila noti msingi hushuka umbali wa tano hadi inayofuata, hivyo mwendo huhisiwa kama kurudi msingi.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Katika C meja, ii–V–I ni zipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: D minori, G, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: D, G, C minori
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: E minori, G, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii ni D minori, V ni G, na I ni C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ongeza noti za saba
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Wapiga jazz kwa kawaida huongeza noti za saba: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Noti za ziada hufanya kila badiliko liwe laini zaidi. Noti msingi na safari ya kurudi hubaki vilevile.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.translation: Katika F meja, ii–V–I ni zipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G minori, C, F
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii ni G minori na V ni C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
rows.translation: Katika ii–V–I, noti msingi husogeaje?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Juu hatua moja kila mara

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: D kushuka hadi G, kisha G kushuka hadi C: umbali wa tano kila mara.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za ii–V–I katika C: D, shuka hadi G, panda hadi C.

rows.translation: Vipimo kumi na viwili
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 ni mpangilio wa kodi wenye urefu wa vipimo kumi na viwili, unaotumika katika melodi nyingi za blues, rock na jazz. Hutumia I, IV na V, mara nyingi zote kama dominant ya saba ili kuleta ladha ya blues.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hii ni blues ya vipimo 12?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mpangilio
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya I. Viwili vya IV, viwili vya I. Kimoja cha V, kimoja cha IV, viwili vya I. Kisha hurudia. Katika A: A7 mara nne, D7 mara mbili, A7 mara mbili, E7, D7, A7 mara mbili.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huanza na vipimo vingapi vya I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Vipimo vinne vya I, kisha IV huja kwenye kipimo 5.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Katika blues ya vipimo 12, kodi ipi iko kwenye kipimo 9?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Kipimo 9 ndicho kipimo kimoja cha V, kabla ya IV kwenye kipimo 10.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Katika ufunguo wa E, kodi tatu za blues ni zipi?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: E7, G7 na A7

rows.translation: E7, A7 na C7

rows.translation: E7, A7 na B7
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: Katika E, I ni E, IV ni A na V ni B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Piga au imba noti msingi za blues katika A: A, D, E, urudi A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Kadensi
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · title

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Kadensi ni badiliko la kodi linalomaliza kishazi, kama alama ya uakifishaji. V kwenda I lina nguvu zaidi, kama nukta. Huitwa kadensi kamili.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Kishazi hiki kinasikika kimekamilika?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Miisho mingine
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV kwenda I ni kadensi ya plagali, amina laini mwishoni mwa tenzi nyingi. Kusimama kwenye V ni kadensi nusu, kama koma. V kwenda vi ni danganyifu: unatarajia msingi, lakini unapata mshangao.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Kadensi ipi humaliza kishazi kwenye V?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kamili

rows.translation: Nusu

rows.translation: Plagali

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Kadensi nusu husimama kwenye V, kama koma.

rows.translation: Nusu (huishia kwenye V)

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Msingini, mbali na kurudi tena. Taja mfuatano, kisha kadensi inayoumaliza. Sikiliza muziki unapotaka kutulia.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · challenge thy-8-6 “Progressions challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.translation: Katika D meja, I–V–vi–IV ni zipi?

rows.translation: Katika D: I ni D, V ni A, vi ni B minori, IV ni G.

rows.translation: Blues ya vipimo 12 huhamia IV kwa mara ya kwanza katika kipimo kipi?

rows.translation: Mdundo
rows.context: Rhythm course · title

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Hisi mapigo, yahesabu, na uyagonge kwa wakati
rows.context: Rhythm course · course subtitle

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Tafuta mapigo, hesabu hadi nne, na ugonge kwa wakati.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 “The beat” · unit summary

rows.translation: Tafuta mapigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · title

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.translation: Pigo ni mwendo thabiti
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Pigo ni mwendo thabiti unaoufuata kwa kugonga mguu. Haliharakishi wala kuchelewa, kama hatua za kutembea kwa utulivu. Kila mdundo hujengwa juu yake.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Gonga pamoja na mlio
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Weka ncha ya kidole juu kidogo ya skrini, ugonge kila mlio unaposikika. Acha iruke kutoka kwenye kioo kama kijiti cha ngoma. Lenga kutua pamoja na mlio, si baada yake.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Pigo huhisiwaje?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Thabiti na sawa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Haraka, kisha polepole
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Sauti kubwa, kisha ndogo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Pigo hudumisha nafasi ileile kati ya midundo, kama saa inayotia tiki.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.translation: Umesikia milio mingapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Hesabu hadi nne
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title

rows.translation: Hesabu kwa sauti: 1, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Muziki mwingi hupanga mapigo katika makundi ya manne. Hesabu 1, 2, 3, 4 kwa sauti pamoja na mlio, kisha anza tena kwenye 1. Kusema namba husaidia mikono kufuata muda.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Vipimo na pigo 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Kipimo ni kundi moja la mapigo. Hapa kila kipimo kina mapigo manne, yakiandikwa 4/4. Pigo 1 huanza kila kipimo, kwa hiyo likazie kidogo unapohesabu.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Mlio wenye nguvu ni pigo 1. Kila kipimo kina mapigo mangapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pigo lipi huanza kila kipimo?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Pigo 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Hesabu huanza tena kwenye 1 mwanzoni mwa kila kipimo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti robo na ndefu zaidi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Noti inayodumu pigo moja ni noti robo. Nne hujaza kipimo cha 4/4, hivyo kugonga kwenye kila pigo ni kugonga noti robo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hesabu zaidi kuliko unavyogonga
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Sasa gonga kwenye 1 na 3 tu. Kila mguso ni noti nusu, yenye mapigo mawili. Endelea kuhesabu yote manne; mapigo unayoruka bado yapo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Unagonga kwenye 1 na 3. Nini hutokea kwenye 2 na 4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Unaendelea kuhesabu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Muziki husimama
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Unagonga kwa kasi mara mbili zaidi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Mapigo hayasimami kamwe. Unahesabu kupitia mapigo usiyoyagonga.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti nzima: pigo 1 tu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo yote manne. Gonga mara moja kwenye 1, uhesabu 2, 3, 4 kwa sauti ndogo ili 1 inayofuata itue kwa wakati.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.translation: Tempo ni kasi ya mapigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo ni kasi ya mapigo, inayohesabiwa kwa mapigo kwa dakika, au bpm. Katika 60 bpm, pigo huja mara moja kwa sekunde, kama saa.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Katika 60 bpm, pigo huja mara ngapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mara mbili kwa sekunde
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mara moja kwa sekunde
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mara moja kila sekunde mbili
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: Mapigo 60 katika sekunde 60 ni pigo moja kila sekunde.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mwendo mdogo kasi inapoongezeka
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Tempo za haraka huhitaji juhudi kidogo zaidi, si nyingi zaidi. Mkono ubaki umelegea, ugonge kwa kusogeza kifundo cha kidole, si cha mkono wala bega.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempo inaongezeka. Miguso yako inapaswa kufanya nini?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kuwa mikubwa na yenye nguvu zaidi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.translation: Kuchelewa kidogo nyuma ya mlio
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kubaki midogo na myepesi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Miwendo midogo iliyolegea ni ya haraka zaidi na rahisi kudumisha kwa usawa.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mikono thabiti
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya mapigo, vipimo, noti ndefu zaidi na tempo. Hesabu kwa sauti muda wote, miguso yako ikiwa midogo na isiyo na mkazo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Noti ipi hudumu kipimo kizima cha 4/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Noti nzima hudumu mapigo manne, kipimo kizima cha 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: 90 bpm inamaanisha nini?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mapigo 90 kila dakika
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Vipimo 90 kila dakika
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Miguso 90 katika kila kipimo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm huhesabu mapigo kwa dakika, hivyo 90 bpm ni pigo moja na nusu kila sekunde.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Gawa kila pigo mara mbili, uhesabu "na."
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 “Eighth notes” · unit summary

rows.translation: Miguso miwili kwa kila pigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · title

rows.translation: Gawa pigo mara mbili
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane hudumu nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hutimia katika kila pigo. Nane hujaza kipimo cha 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hesabu 1 na 2 na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Sema namba kwenye kila pigo na "na" katikati kabisa: 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na. Gonga kwenye kila neno.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Noti ya nane ni nusu ya pigo, hivyo mbili hujaza kila pigo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Milio yenye nguvu ndiyo mapigo. Umesikia mapigo mangapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti robo na za nane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · title

rows.translation: Changanya ndefu na fupi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Sasa baadhi ya mapigo hupata mguso mmoja na mengine miwili. Endelea kusema kila "na," hata usizozigonga.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.translation: Unahesabuje mfumo huu?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Pigo 1 lina miguso miwili, 1 na. Mapigo 2, 3 na 4 hupata mguso mmoja kila moja.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Soma hesabu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · title

rows.translation: Kila mguso una jina
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Katika noti za nane, kila mguso huangukia namba au "na." Kabla ya kugonga mfumo mpya, sema hesabu zake mara moja kwa sauti.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hesabu zipi zinalingana na mfumo huu?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 1, 2 na, 3 na 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1 na 2, 3 na 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1 na 2 na 3 na 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Mapigo 1 na 3 yana miguso miwili kila moja; mapigo 2 na 4 yana mmoja.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: 1, 2 na 3 na 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1 na 2, 3, 4 na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1, 2, 3 na 4 na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Pigo 1 lina mguso mmoja, mapigo 2 na 3 yana miwili, na pigo 4 lina mmoja.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti za nane zilizo sawa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · title

rows.translation: Fanya nusu zote mbili zilingane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: "Na" inapaswa kuangukia katikati kabisa ya mapigo. Noti zako za nane zikisikika kama mwendo wa farasi, punguza kasi na useme hesabu unapogonga.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Noti zako za nane hazisikiki sawa. Nini husaidia zaidi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.translation: Punguza kasi na uhesabu kwa sauti
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Gonga kwa nguvu zaidi kwenye kila pigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.translation: Ongeza kasi hadi zisikike sawa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Kupunguza kasi hukupa muda wa kuweka kila "na" katikati. Kuhesabu huidumisha hapo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Weka ncha ya kidole karibu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Kaa juu kidogo tu ya kioo kati ya miguso. Mwendo mfupi mwepesi ni rahisi kudumisha kwa usawa katika tempo za haraka zaidi.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Jaribio la noti za nane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya noti robo na za nane. Sema hesabu za kila mfumo mara moja, kisha ugonge kila "na" ikiwa katikati kabisa.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: 1 na 2 na 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapumziko na sinkopa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · title

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Acha nafasi kwa makusudi, kisha ugonge kati ya mapigo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · unit summary

rows.translation: Mapumziko huhesabiwa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · title

rows.translation: Pumziko ni ukimya unaohesabiwa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Pumziko ni ukimya wenye muda maalumu. Bado unauhesabu; hugongi tu. Pumziko robo hudumu pigo moja.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.translation: Unafanya nini wakati wa pumziko?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Rukia noti inayofuata
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Gonga kwa upole
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Lihesabu kimya kimya
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Pumziko huchukua muda kama noti. Kulihesabu hukusaidia ujue ulipo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Pumzika kwenye pigo 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Kuacha pigo 1 tupu ndilo pumziko gumu zaidi. Tikisa kichwa kwenye 1 ili ulihisi bila kugonga, kisha ingia kwenye 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Gonga na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · title

rows.translation: Pumzika, kisha gonga na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Pumziko la nane hudumu nusu ya pigo. Hesabu 1 na 2 na, pumzika kwenye 2, kisha gonga "na" yake badala yake. Huhisiwa kama msukumo mdogo kuelekea pigo 3.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Mguso wa pili uko wapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye pigo 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye "na" ya 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye pigo 3
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Uko katikati ya mapigo 2 na 3, kwenye "na" ya 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Sinkopa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · title

rows.translation: Sinkopa: kati ya mapigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huweka noti yenye mkazo kati ya mapigo, mahali ambapo sikio halitarajii. Huufanya mdundo uhisiwe unaelekea mbele.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hesabu kila noti ya nane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Mfumo huu huangukia 1, "na" ya 2, na 4. Hesabu 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na, ugonge sehemu hizo tatu tu.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Hesabu milio kutoka 1 hadi 8. Yenye nguvu huangukia wapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: 1 na 5
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Nini huufanya mdundo uwe na sinkopa?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti kwenye pigo 1 tu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti zenye mkazo kati ya mapigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Sinkopa huhamisha mkazo kutoka pigo kuu hadi "na" au pigo dhaifu.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · title

rows.translation: Gonga na tu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati ni "na" kati ya mapigo makuu. Tikisa kichwa kwenye namba, ugonge na tu, kama chop ya gitaa la reggae.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Mlio wa kwanza ni pigo 1. Milio yenye nguvu iko kwenye namba au na?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kwenye namba
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati huangukia wapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Kati ya mapigo, kwenye "na"
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Kwenye kila pigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Mapigo ya katikati huangukia katikati kabisa ya mapigo makuu, kwenye kila "na."
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Nafasi na msukumo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya mapumziko, "na" peke yake, sinkopa na mapigo ya katikati. Hesabu kila noti ya nane kwa sauti, hata usipogonga.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Ni ipi kati ya hizi ina sinkopa?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: 1 na 2 na 3 na 4 na
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Kugonga "na" ya 2 na kuruka 3 huhamisha mkazo kutoka pigo kuu.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Viungo vya tie na nukta
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · title

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Shikilia noti zivuke mapigo kwa viungo vya tie na midundo yenye nukta.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · unit summary

rows.translation: Viungo vya tie
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · title

rows.translation: Tie huunganisha noti mbili
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Tie ni mstari uliopinda unaounganisha noti mbili. Unapiga ya kwanza na kuishikilia kupitia ya pili, hivyo noti iliyounganishwa haigongwi upya.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Pigo 2 limeunganishwa na pigo 3 kwa tie. Unafanya nini kwenye 3?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Endelea kushikilia, usigonge tena
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Gonga tena
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Simamisha sauti na usubiri
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Tie huongeza muda wa noti moja. Unahesabu 3, lakini noti ya pigo 2 inaendelea kulia.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tie inayovuka pigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Unganisha "na" ya 2 na pigo 3 kwa tie. Gonga kwenye "na," kisha acha pigo 3 lipite noti ikiendelea kulia. Ni sinkopa, iliyoandikwa kwa namna nyingine.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Nukta hufanya nini
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · title

rows.translation: Nukta huongeza nusu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Nukta baada ya noti huongeza nusu ya muda wake. Noti nusu hudumu mapigo mawili, hivyo yenye nukta hudumu matatu. Gonga 1, hesabu 2 na 3, gonga 4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Noti robo hudumu pigo moja. Yenye nukta hudumu kwa muda gani?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Nusu ya pigo moja ni nusu pigo. Ukiongeza, unapata moja na nusu.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta hudumu pigo moja na nusu, hivyo noti inayofuata huangukia "na." Hesabu 1 na 2 na: gonga 1, kisha "na" ya 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Uligonga mfumo huu wenye pumziko katika Kitengo 3. Nini hubadilika kwa nukta?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Noti ya kwanza hulia kwa muda mrefu zaidi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Miguso huhama
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Tempo hupungua
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Miguso huangukia sehemu zilezile. Muda wa noti ya kwanza tu ndio hubadilika.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Ndefu, fupi
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · title

rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta, kisha ya nane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta pamoja na ya nane hujaza mapigo mawili: ndefu, fupi. Hesabu 1 na 2 na; gonga 1 na "na" ya 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Noti robo yenye nukta na ya nane hudumu kwa muda gani pamoja?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mapigo matatu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Moja na nusu pamoja na nusu ni mbili.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Ipi hudumu sawa na noti robo yenye nukta?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.translation: Robo iliyounganishwa na ya nane kwa tie
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti mbili za nane
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Tie huongeza nusu ya pigo kwenye noti robo, kama nukta inavyofanya.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Noti zinazoshikiliwa
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Changamoto hii huchanganya viungo vya tie na nukta. Hesabu kila noti ya nane kwa sauti; noti inayoshikiliwa bado huchukua muda wake wote.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Noti nusu yenye nukta hudumu kwa muda gani?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Noti nusu ni mapigo mawili; nukta huongeza moja zaidi.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Tie huunganisha noti mbili. Unagonga mara ngapi?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Unagonga noti ya kwanza na kuishikilia kupitia ya pili.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Tripleti na swing
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · title

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Gawa pigo mara tatu, kisha piga noti za nane kwa swing.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · unit summary

rows.translation: Tatu kwa pigo
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · title

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.translation: Tripleti hugawa pigo mara tatu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Tripleti huweka noti tatu sawa katika pigo moja. Hesabu 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, kila silabi ikiwa na muda uleule.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Noti ngapi za tripleti hutimia katika pigo moja?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Tripleti hugawa kila pigo katika sehemu tatu sawa.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Milio iko katika makundi ya mbili au tatu?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Makundi ya mbili
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Makundi ya tatu
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
